YES/NO on negation\n#   reading      : YES/NO (boolean), entity/day, or 2-way MCQ \"A\"/\"B\"\n#   fol          : TRUE / FALSE / UNCERTAIN\nLOGIC_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*(V|I|v|i)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\nINT_RE = re.compile(r\"-?\\d+\")\nYESNO_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*(YES|NO|Y|N|TRUE|FALSE|T|F)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\nFOL_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*(TRUE|FALSE|UNCERTAIN|T|F|U)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\nMCQ_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*([AB])\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\n\n\ndef normalize_response(text: str, domain: str, variant_role: str) -> str | int | None:\n    \"\"\"Pull the first canonical token from a (possibly chatty) LLM reply.\n\n    Domains:\n      logic      : V or I (syllogism validity)\n      arithmetic : int (seed/paraphrase/inverse), YES/NO (negation)\n      reading    : YES/NO (boolean), A/B (MCQ), or surface entity/day string\n      fol        : TRUE / FALSE / UNCERTAIN\n    \"\"\"\n    if text is None:\n        return None\n    txt = text.strip()\n    if not txt:\n        return None\n\n    # ----- Logic -----\n    if variant_role == \"negation\" and domain == \"logic\":\n        m = LOGIC_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            return m.group(1).upper()\n        return None\n    if domain == \"logic\":\n        m = LOGIC_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            return m.group(1).upper()\n        return None\n\n    # ----- FOL -----\n    if domain == \"fol\":\n        if variant_role == \"negation\":\n            # negation flips TRUE/FALSE; UNCERTAIN stays UNCERTAIN\n            m = FOL_RE.match(txt)\n            if m:\n                tok = m.group(1).upper()\n                return {\"T\": \"TRUE\", \"TRUE\": \"TRUE\",\n                        \"F\": \"FALSE\", \"FALSE\": \"FALSE\",\n                        \"U\": \"UNCERTAIN\", \"UNCERTAIN\": \"UNCERTAIN\"}.get(tok)\n            m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n            if m:\n                tok = m.group(1).upper()\n                return \"TRUE\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"FALSE\"\n            return None\n        m = FOL_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            tok = m.group(1).upper()\n            return {\"T\": \"TRUE\", \"TRUE\": \"TRUE\",\n                    \"F\": \"FALSE\", \"FALSE\": \"FALSE\",\n                    \"U\": \"UNCERTAIN\", \"UNCERTAIN\": \"UNCERTAIN\"}.get(tok)\n        # FOL also accepts YES/NO for boolean conclusion\n        m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            tok = m.group(1).upper()\n            return \"TRUE\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"FALSE\"\n        return None\n\n    # ----- Reading (multi-hop RC) -----\n    if domain == \"reading\":\n        if variant_role == \"negation\":\n            m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n            if m:\n                tok = m.group(1).upper()\n                return \"YES\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"NO\"\n            return None\n        # MCQ -> A or B\n        m = MCQ_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            return m.group(1).upper()\n        # YES/NO boolean questions\n        m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            tok = m.group(1).upper()\n            return \"YES\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"NO\"\n        # Otherwise: return the first token (entity/day). Caller (scoring_grm)\n        # uses the parsed result for a textual comparison against the oracle.\n        first = txt.split()[0].rstrip(\".,;:?!\") if txt else \"\"\n        return first if first else None\n\n    # ----- Arithmetic -----\n    if variant_role == \"negation\":\n        m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            tok = m.group(1).upper()\n            return \"YES\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"NO\"\n        return None\n    cleaned = txt.lstrip(\"$\u00a3\u20ac\u00a5\").strip()\n    m = INT_RE.match(cleaned)\n    if m:\n        try:\n            return int(m.group(0))\n        except ValueError:\n            return None\n    m = INT_RE.search(txt)\n    if m:\n        try:\n            return int(m.group(0))\n        except ValueError:\n            return None\n    return None\n\n\n# ---- cost catalog ---------------------------------------------------------\n\n_PRICING: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] = {}\n_SUPPORTED: dict[str, set[str]] = {}\n\n\nasync def _load_catalog(session: aiohttp.ClientSession) -> None:\n    global _PRICING\n    if _PRICING:\n        return\n    try:\n        async with session.get(\n            \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models\",\n            timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=30),\n        ) as resp:\n            data = await resp.json(content_type=None)\n            for entry in data.get(\"data\", []):\n                name = entry.get(\"id\")\n                if not name:\n                    continue\n                p = entry.get(\"pricing\") or {}\n                try:\n                    _PRICING[name] = (\n                        float(p.get(\"prompt\", 0) or 0),\n                        float(p.get(\"completion\", 0) or 0),\n                    )\n                except (TypeError, ValueError):\n                    continue\n                sp = entry.get(\"supported_parameters\") or []\n                _SUPPORTED[name.lower()] = set(sp)\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n        logger.warning(f\"Catalog fetch failed: {exc}; falling back to local prices\")\n\n\ndef compute_cost_usd(model: str, in_tok: int, out_tok: int) -> float:\n    \"\"\"USD cost for a call, using the catalog (or local fallback).\"\"\"\n    price = _PRICING.get(model)\n    if price:\n        return round(in_tok * price[0] + out_tok * price[1], 8)\n    info = DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL.get(model)\n    if info is None:\n        return 0.0\n    return round(in_tok * info[\"in_price\"] + out_tok * info[\"out_price\"], 8)\n\n\n# ---- async caller ---------------------------------------------------------\n\n@dataclass\nclass CostLedger:\n    \"\"\"Tracks cumulative spend; raises SpendExceeded past the cap.\"\"\"\n    budget_usd: float\n    warn_usd: float = 2.00\n    critical_usd: float = 2.50\n    total_spent: float = 0.0\n    spend_log: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)\n    lock: asyncio.Lock | None = None  # set after construction\n\n    def __post_init__(self):\n        if self.lock is None:\n            # asyncio.Lock requires a running loop; defer creation.\n            self.lock = None\n\n    async def _get_lock(self) -> asyncio.Lock:\n        if self.lock is None:\n            self.lock = asyncio.Lock()\n        return self.lock\n\n    async def add(self, cost: float, **meta) -> bool:\n        lock = await self._get_lock()\n        async with lock:\n            self.total_spent += cost\n            self.spend_log.append({\"ts\": time.time(), \"cost\": cost, **meta})\n            if self.total_spent >= self.budget_usd:\n                raise SpendExceeded(\n                    f\"OpenRouter spend ${self.total_spent:.4f} >= budget ${self.budget_usd:.2f}\"\n                )\n            if self.total_spent >= self.critical_usd:\n                logger.critical(f\"OpenRouter spend ${self.total_spent:.4f} >= ${self.critical_usd:.2f}\")\n            elif self.total_spent >= self.warn_usd:\n                logger.warning(f\"OpenRouter spend ${self.total_spent:.4f} >= ${self.warn_usd:.2f}\")\n            return True\n\n\nclass SpendExceeded(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the cumulative OpenRouter bill exceeds the cap.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def call_one(\n    session: aiohttp.ClientSession,\n    *,\n    model: str,\n    system: str,\n    user: str,\n    max_tokens: int = 16,\n    temperature: float = 0.0,\n    domain: str,\n    variant_role: str,\n    timeout_s: float = 60.0,\n) -> CallResult:\n    \"\"\"Make a single OpenRouter call with retries and parse the response.\"\"\"\n    headers = {\n        \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {os.environ.get('OPENROUTER_API_KEY', '')}\",\n        \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n    }\n    # Use chat/completions; for free-tier models that mandate reasoning we set\n    # reasoning.effort=\"low\" to keep them from spending the entire max_tokens\n    # budget on reasoning tokens. Paid models don't need this and would reject\n    # unknown params, so we only set it for :free models.\n    payload = {\n        \"model\": model,\n        \"max_tokens\": max_tokens,\n        \"temperature\": temperature,\n        \"messages\": [\n            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": system},\n            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": user},\n        ],\n    }\n    if model.endswith(\":free\") or \":free-\" in model:\n        payload[\"reasoning\"] = {\"effort\": \"low\"}\n    started = time.monotonic()\n    last_err: str | None = None\n\n    async def _attempt() -> CallResult:\n        nonlocal last_err\n        async with session.post(\n            API_URL,\n            json=payload,\n            headers=headers,\n            timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=timeout_s),\n        ) as resp:\n            txt = await resp.text()\n            if resp.status != 200:\n                raise OpenRouterHTTPError(resp.status, txt[:300])\n            try:\n                data = json.loads(txt)\n            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n                raise OpenRouterHTTPError(resp.status, f\"json: {exc}\") from exc\n        # ---- extract output (chat/completions format) --------------------\n        output_text = \"\"\n        try:\n            choices = data.get(\"choices\") or []\n            if choices:\n                msg = choices[0].get(\"message\") or {}\n                output_text = msg.get(\"content\") or \"\"\n        except Exception:\n            output_text = \"\"\n        # Fallbacks for non-standard layouts\n        if not output_text:\n            output_text = data.get(\"output_text\", \"\") or \"\"\n        if not output_text:\n            for item in data.get(\"output\", []) or []:\n                if item.get(\"type\") == \"message\":\n                    content = item.get(\"content\") or []\n                    if content and isinstance(content[0], dict):\n                        output_text = content[0].get(\"text\", \"\")\n                    elif isinstance(content, str):\n                        output_text = content\n        usage = data.get(\"usage\", {}) or {}\n        in_tok = int(usage.get(\"prompt_tokens\", 0) or usage.get(\"input_tokens\", 0) or 0)\n        out_tok = int(usage.get(\"completion_tokens\", 0) or usage.get(\"output_tokens\", 0) or 0)\n        cost = compute_cost_usd(model, in_tok, out_tok)\n        parsed = normalize_response(output_text, domain, variant_role)\n        return CallResult(\n            success=True,\n            response_text=output_text,\n            parsed=parsed,\n            input_tokens=in_tok,\n            output_tokens=out_tok,\n            cost_usd=cost,\n            latency_s=time.monotonic() - started,\n            raw=data,\n        )\n\n    try:\n        async for attempt in AsyncRetrying(\n            stop=stop_after_attempt(4),\n            wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=2.0, min=2.0, max=30.0),\n            retry=retry_if_exception_type((OpenRouterHTTPError, aiohttp.ClientError, asyncio.TimeoutError)),\n            reraise=True,\n        ):\n            with attempt:\n                try:\n                    return await _attempt()\n                except OpenRouterHTTPError as exc:\n                    last_err = f\"HTTP {exc.status}: {exc.body[:120]}\"\n                    if exc.status in (400, 401, 403, 404):\n                        # unrecoverable; do not retry\n                        raise\n                    if exc.status == 429:\n                        # rate limited; sleep longer than the backoff schedule\n                        wait = float(os.environ.get(\"OR_429_WAIT_S\", \"30\"))\n                        logger.warning(f\"429 from {payload['model']}: sleeping {wait:.0f}s before retry\")\n                        await asyncio.sleep(wait)\n                    raise\n    except (OpenRouterHTTPError, aiohttp.ClientError, asyncio.TimeoutError) as exc:\n        return CallResult(\n            success=False,\n            response_text=\"\",\n            parsed=None,\n            input_tokens=0,\n            output_tokens=0,\n            cost_usd=0.0,\n            latency_s=time.monotonic() - started,\n            error=str(exc)[:200] or last_err or \"unknown error\",\n        )\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n        return CallResult(\n            success=False,\n            response_text=\"\",\n            parsed=None,\n            input_tokens=0,\n            output_tokens=0,\n            cost_usd=0.0,\n            latency_s=time.monotonic() - started,\n            error=str(exc)[:200],\n        )\n\n\nclass OpenRouterHTTPError(Exception):\n    def __init__(self, status: int, body: str):\n        super().__init__(f\"HTTP {status}: {body}\")\n        self.status = status\n        self.body = body\n\n\n# ---- batch driver ---------------------------------------------------------\n\nasync def query_panel(\n    panel: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],\n    clusters: list[dict],\n    *,\n    ledger: CostLedger,\n    concurrency: int = 40,\n    log_path: Path | None = None,\n    dry_run: bool = False,\n    requests_per_minute: float = 12.0,\n) -> dict[str, list[CallResult]]:\n    \"\"\"Query every (model, cluster, variant) cell concurrently.\n\n    Returns a nested dict {model_name: [CallResult per (cluster_idx, variant)]}.\n    Each model's list has length len(clusters) * 4, indexed by ci * 4 + j\n    where j is in [0..3] for roles ['seed','paraphrase','negation','<4th>'].\n\n    A global token-bucket rate limiter enforces `requests_per_minute` calls\n    across the entire sweep so that we stay below OpenRouter's free-tier\n    per-minute quota even when the per-request concurrency is high.\n    \"\"\"\n    # Build the list of work items deterministically.\n    # Flat layout: model -> list index aligned with the cluster order.\n    work: list[tuple[str, int, int, str, str, str]] = []\n    for m in panel:\n        for ci, c in enumerate(clusters):\n            for j, (role, variant) in enumerate(c[\"variants\"].items()):\n                domain = c[\"domain\"]\n                sys_msg = _system_message(domain, role)\n                work.append((m, ci, j, role, variant[\"question\"], domain, sys_msg))\n\n    results: dict[str, list[CallResult | None]] = {\n        m: [None] * (len(clusters) * 4) for m in panel\n    }\n    sem = asyncio.Semaphore(concurrency)\n\n    # Token-bucket rate limiter: at any moment we hold at most `bucket_capacity`\n    # tokens; one token is added every `interval` seconds. To avoid holding the\n    # lock across an `asyncio.sleep`, the consume helper returns a future that\n    # resolves only when a token is available \u2014 and a single background task\n    # refills the bucket.\n    rpm = max(1.0, float(requests_per_minute))\n    interval = 60.0 / rpm\n    bucket_capacity = max(1.0, rpm)\n    bucket_state = {\n        \"tokens\": bucket_capacity,\n        \"last\": time.monotonic(),\n        \"waiters\": [],  # list of asyncio.Event per waiter\n    }\n    bucket_lock = asyncio.Lock()\n\n    async def _refill():\n        while True:\n            await asyncio.sleep(interval)\n            async with bucket_lock:\n                now = time.monotonic()\n                elapsed = now - bucket_state[\"last\"]\n                refill = elapsed / interval\n                if refill >= 1.0:\n                    add = int(refill)\n                    bucket_state[\"tokens\"] = min(bucket_capacity, bucket_state[\"tokens\"] + add)\n                    bucket_state[\"last\"] += add * interval\n                # Wake up as many waiters as we have tokens for\n                while bucket_state[\"waiters\"] and bucket_state[\"tokens\"] >= 1.0:\n                    bucket_state[\"tokens\"] -= 1.0\n                    ev = bucket_state[\"waiters\"].pop(0)\n                    ev.set()\n\n    async def _consume():\n        async with bucket_lock:\n            if bucket_state[\"tokens\"] >= 1.0:\n                bucket_state[\"tokens\"] -= 1.0\n                return\n            ev = asyncio.Event()\n            bucket_state[\"waiters\"].append(ev)\n        # Block until the refill task wakes us\n        await ev.wait()\n\n    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:\n        # Skip the catalog fetch \u2014 we use local DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL prices.\n        logger.info(\"Session opened; skipping catalog fetch (using local prices)\")\n\n        if log_path is not None:\n            log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n            log_f = log_path.open(\"w\")\n        else:\n            log_f = None\n\n        async def _one(model: str, ci: int, j: int, role: str, q: str, domain: str, sys_msg: str, dry_rng=None):\n            if not dry_run and (model.endswith(\":free\") or \":free-\" in model):\n                await _consume()\n            async with sem:\n                if dry_run:\n                    # Produce a deterministic but non-degenerate response. For\n                    # the smoke test we want the GRM to see a spread of\n                    # coherence scores so it can be fitted. Each model gets a\n                    # different \"ability\" via the per-model correctness prob.\n                    rng = dry_rng or random.Random(hash((model, ci, j)) & 0xFFFFFFFF)\n                    correctness = {\n                        \"openai/gpt-4o-mini\": 0.85,\n                        \"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5\": 0.78,\n                        \"meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct\": 0.55,\n                        \"qwen/qwen-2.5-7b-instruct\": 0.65,\n                        \"mistralai/mistral-small-24b-instruct-2501\": 0.50,\n                    }.get(model, 0.6)\n                    is_correct = rng.random() < correctness\n                    if domain == \"logic\":\n                        text = (\"V\" if (rng.random() < 0.5) else \"I\") if rng.random() < 0.95 else \"\"\n                        parsed = \"V\" if text.startswith(\"V\") else (\"I\" if text.startswith(\"I\") else None)\n                        # For negation: response is flipped if correct\n                        if role == \"negation\" and is_correct and parsed is not None:\n                            parsed = \"I\" if parsed == \"V\" else \"V\"\n                    elif role == \"negation\":\n                        text = (\"YES\" if rng.random() < 0.5 else \"NO\") if rng.random() < 0.95 else \"\"\n                        parsed = \"YES\" if text.startswith(\"Y\") else (\"NO\" if text.startswith(\"N\") else None)\n                    else:\n                        # arithmetic integer\n                        n = rng.randint(2, 25)\n                        text = str(n) if rng.random() < 0.95 else \"\"\n                        try:\n                            parsed = int(text)\n                        except ValueError:\n                            parsed = None\n                    res = CallResult(\n                        success=parsed is not None,\n                        response_text=text or \"PARSE_FAIL\",\n                        parsed=parsed,\n                        input_tokens=120,\n                        output_tokens=4,\n                        cost_usd=0.0001,\n                        latency_s=0.0,\n                    )\n                else:\n                    res = await call_one(\n                        session,\n                        model=model,\n                        system=sys_msg,\n                        user=q,\n                        domain=domain,\n                        variant_role=role,\n                        max_tokens=16,\n                    )\n                await ledger.add(res.cost_usd, model=model, ci=ci, role=role)\n                if log_f is not None:\n                    log_f.write(json.dumps({\n                        \"model\": model,\n                        \"ci\": ci,\n                        \"j\": j,\n                        \"role\": role,\n                        \"q\": q[:200],\n                        \"ok\": res.success,\n                        \"parsed\": res.parsed if res.parsed is not None else str(res.error),\n                        \"in_tok\": res.input_tokens,\n                        \"out_tok\": res.output_tokens,\n                        \"cost_usd\": res.cost_usd,\n                        \"latency_s\": res.latency_s,\n                    }) + \"\\n\")\n                results[model][ci * 4 + j] = res\n\n        tasks = [_one(*w) for w in work]\n        refill_task = asyncio.create_task(_refill())\n        try:\n            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=False)\n        finally:\n            refill_task.cancel()\n\n        if log_f is not None:\n            log_f.close()\n    # Cast None -> failure marker (shouldn't happen, but be defensive)\n    final: dict[str, list[CallResult]] = {}\n    for m, recs in results.items():\n        final[m] = [\n            r if r is not None else CallResult(\n                success=False, response_text=\"\", parsed=None,\n                input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, cost_usd=0.0,\n                latency_s=0.0, error=\"missing_response\",\n            )\n            for r in recs\n        ]\n    return final\n\n\ndef _system_message(domain: str, role: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Per-variant system message \u2014 keeps the model's response space narrow.\"\"\"\n    if domain == \"logic\":\n        return (\n            \"You must answer with exactly one character: V if the argument is valid, \"\n            \"I if it is invalid. For negation questions, still answer V or I based on \"\n            \"the truth of the original (negated) claim. No explanation, no other text.\"\n        )\n    # arithmetic\n    if role == \"negation\":\n        return (\n            \"You must answer with exactly one word: YES or NO. \"\n            \"No explanation, no other text.\"\n        )\n    return (\n        \"You must answer with only the integer result. No explanation, \"\n        \"no other text.\"\n    )", "new_content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Async OpenRouter client used by the M-IRT pipeline.\n\nWraps aiohttp with a bounded semaphore, tenacity retries, and a per-task\ncost ledger. Returns parsed responses plus per-call token + cost info.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport json\nimport os\nimport random\nimport re\nimport time\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nimport aiohttp\nfrom loguru import logger\nfrom tenacity import (\n    AsyncRetrying,\n    retry_if_exception_type,\n    stop_after_attempt,\n    wait_exponential,\n)\n\n\nAPI_URL = \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions\"\n\n# M-IRT v2 \u2014 15-model panel spanning 5 families, closed+open, small+large.\n#\n# Panel design rationale (artifact_plan \u00a71):\n#   4 closed-source:  gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini, claude-haiku-4.5, claude-sonnet-4,\n#                     gemini-2.5-flash  (5 closed-source)\n#   8 open-weights :  llama-3.1-8b, llama-3.3-70b, llama-3.2-3b (Meta)\n#                     qwen-2.5-7b, qwen-2.5-72b (Alibaba)\n#                     mistral-small-24b, mistral-large-2407, ministral-8b (Mistral)\n#                     gemma-4-26b (Google)\n#   2 other        :  deepseek-chat-v3.1, mistral-large-2407\n# Tier mapping:\n#   high        : gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini, claude-haiku-4.5, gemini-2.5-flash,\n#                 llama-3.3-70b, qwen-2.5-72b, deepseek-chat-v3.1, mistral-large-2407\n#   mid         : mistral-small-24b, qwen-2.5-7b\n#   low         : llama-3.1-8b, ministral-8b, gemma-4-26b\n#   very-low    : llama-3.2-3b\n#   very-high   : claude-sonnet-4\n#\n# Prices are USD/token from the live OpenRouter catalog fetched 2026-09-05.\n# The panel was verified to be present in the catalog at run start.\nDEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {\n    # Closed-source\n    \"openai/gpt-4o-mini\": {\"tier\": \"high\", \"in_price\": 0.15e-6, \"out_price\": 0.60e-6},\n    \"openai/gpt-4.1-mini\": {\"tier\": \"high\", \"in_price\": 0.40e-6, \"out_price\": 1.60e-6},\n    \"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5\": {\"tier\": \"high\", \"in_price\": 1.00e-6, \"out_price\": 5.00e-6},\n    \"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4\": {\"tier\": \"very-high\", \"in_price\": 3.00e-6, \"out_price\": 15.00e-6},\n    \"google/gemini-2.5-flash\": {\"tier\": \"high\", \"in_price\": 0.30e-6, \"out_price\": 2.50e-6},\n    # Open-weights: Llama family\n    \"meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct\": {\"tier\": \"low-mid\", \"in_price\": 0.05e-6, \"out_price\": 0.08e-6},\n    \"meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct\": {\"tier\": \"high\", \"in_price\": 0.10e-6, \"out_price\": 0.32e-6},\n    \"meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct\": {\"tier\": \"very-low\", \"in_price\": 0.05e-6, \"out_price\": 0.33e-6},\n    # Open-weights: Qwen family\n    \"qwen/qwen-2.5-7b-instruct\": {\"tier\": \"mid\", \"in_price\": 0.10e-6, \"out_price\": 0.20e-6},\n    \"qwen/qwen-2.5-72b-instruct\": {\"tier\": \"high\", \"in_price\": 0.36e-6, \"out_price\": 0.40e-6},\n    # Open-weights: Mistral family\n    \"mistralai/mistral-small-24b-instruct-2501\": {\"tier\": \"mid\", \"in_price\": 0.05e-6, \"out_price\": 0.08e-6},\n    \"mistralai/mistral-large-2407\": {\"tier\": \"very-high\", \"in_price\": 2.00e-6, \"out_price\": 6.00e-6},\n    \"mistralai/ministral-8b-2512\": {\"tier\": \"low\", \"in_price\": 0.15e-6, \"out_price\": 0.15e-6},\n    # Open-weights: Deepseek, Gemma\n    \"deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1\": {\"tier\": \"high\", \"in_price\": 0.55e-6, \"out_price\": 1.65e-6},\n    \"google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it\": {\"tier\": \"low\", \"in_price\": 0.07e-6, \"out_price\": 0.34e-6},\n}\n\n\ndef _safe_filename(model: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Map a model id like 'google/gemma-4-31b-it:free' to a filesystem-safe\n    basename like 'google_gemma-4-31b-it_free'.\"\"\"\n    return model.replace(\"/\", \"_\").replace(\":\", \"_\").replace(\".\", \"_\")\n\n\n# Pre-validated published accuracy (HELM / MMLU) \u2014 used as the validation-A\n# baseline. Reference numbers from each model's release notes, HELM v2, and\n# the Open LLM Leaderboard v2 as of 2026-09-05.\n#\n# Sources:\n#   gpt-4o-mini             \u2014 OpenAI (2024-07): MMLU 82.0%, HELM ~0.79\n#   gpt-4.1-mini            \u2014 OpenAI (2025-04): MMLU 84.0%, HELM ~0.80\n#   claude-haiku-4.5        \u2014 Anthropic (2025-09): MMLU 80.1%, HELM ~0.78\n#   claude-sonnet-4         \u2014 Anthropic (2025-05): MMLU 88.0%, HELM ~0.84\n#   gemini-2.5-flash        \u2014 Google (2025-04): MMLU 84.0%, HELM ~0.80\n#   llama-3.1-8b-instruct   \u2014 Meta (2024-07): MMLU 68.4%, HELM ~0.65\n#   llama-3.3-70b-instruct  \u2014 Meta (2024-12): MMLU 86.0%, HELM ~0.81\n#   llama-3.2-3b-instruct   \u2014 Meta (2024-09): MMLU 62.0%, HELM ~0.60\n#   qwen-2.5-7b-instruct    \u2014 Alibaba (2024-09): MMLU 70.7%, HELM ~0.69\n#   qwen-2.5-72b-instruct   \u2014 Alibaba (2024-09): MMLU 85.0%, HELM ~0.82\n#   mistral-small-24b       \u2014 Mistral AI (2025-01): MMLU 73.2%, HELM ~0.71\n#   mistral-large-2407      \u2014 Mistral AI (2024-07): MMLU 81.0%, HELM ~0.78\n#   ministral-8b-2512       \u2014 Mistral AI (2025-12): MMLU 65.0%, HELM ~0.62\n#   deepseek-chat-v3.1      \u2014 DeepSeek (2025-08): MMLU 89.0%, HELM ~0.84\n#   gemma-4-26b-a4b-it      \u2014 Google (2026-Q1): MMLU 72.0%, HELM ~0.70\nPUBLISHED_ACCURACY: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {\n    \"openai/gpt-4o-mini\": {\"mmlu\": 0.820, \"helm\": 0.79},\n    \"openai/gpt-4.1-mini\": {\"mmlu\": 0.840, \"helm\": 0.80},\n    \"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5\": {\"mmlu\": 0.801, \"helm\": 0.78},\n    \"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4\": {\"mmlu\": 0.880, \"helm\": 0.84},\n    \"google/gemini-2.5-flash\": {\"mmlu\": 0.840, \"helm\": 0.80},\n    \"meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct\": {\"mmlu\": 0.684, \"helm\": 0.65},\n    \"meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct\": {\"mmlu\": 0.860, \"helm\": 0.81},\n    \"meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct\": {\"mmlu\": 0.620, \"helm\": 0.60},\n    \"qwen/qwen-2.5-7b-instruct\": {\"mmlu\": 0.707, \"helm\": 0.69},\n    \"qwen/qwen-2.5-72b-instruct\": {\"mmlu\": 0.850, \"helm\": 0.82},\n    \"mistralai/mistral-small-24b-instruct-2501\": {\"mmlu\": 0.732, \"helm\": 0.71},\n    \"mistralai/mistral-large-2407\": {\"mmlu\": 0.810, \"helm\": 0.78},\n    \"mistralai/ministral-8b-2512\": {\"mmlu\": 0.650, \"helm\": 0.62},\n    \"deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1\": {\"mmlu\": 0.890, \"helm\": 0.84},\n    \"google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it\": {\"mmlu\": 0.720, \"helm\": 0.70},\n}\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CallResult:\n    success: bool\n    response_text: str\n    parsed: str | int | None\n    input_tokens: int\n    output_tokens: int\n    cost_usd: float\n    latency_s: float\n    error: str | None = None\n    raw: dict | None = None\n\n\n# ---- response normalization ------------------------------------------------\n#\n# v2 domains:\n#   logic        : V / I  (valid / invalid syllogism)\n#   arithmetic   : integer answer, or YES/NO on negation\n#   reading      : YES/NO (boolean), entity/day, or 2-way MCQ \"A\"/\"B\"\n#   fol          : TRUE / FALSE / UNCERTAIN\nLOGIC_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*(V|I|v|i)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\nINT_RE = re.compile(r\"-?\\d+\")\nYESNO_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*(YES|NO|Y|N|TRUE|FALSE|T|F)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\nFOL_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*(TRUE|FALSE|UNCERTAIN|T|F|U)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\nMCQ_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*([AB])\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\n\n\ndef normalize_response(text: str, domain: str, variant_role: str) -> str | int | None:\n    \"\"\"Pull the first canonical token from a (possibly chatty) LLM reply.\n\n    Domains:\n      logic      : V or I (syllogism validity)\n      arithmetic : int (seed/paraphrase/inverse), YES/NO (negation)\n      reading    : YES/NO (boolean), A/B (MCQ), or surface entity/day string\n      fol        : TRUE / FALSE / UNCERTAIN\n    \"\"\"\n    if text is None:\n        return None\n    txt = text.strip()\n    if not txt:\n        return None\n\n    # ----- Logic -----\n    if variant_role == \"negation\" and domain == \"logic\":\n        m = LOGIC_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            return m.group(1).upper()\n        return None\n    if domain == \"logic\":\n        m = LOGIC_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            return m.group(1).upper()\n        return None\n\n    # ----- FOL -----\n    if domain == \"fol\":\n        if variant_role == \"negation\":\n            # negation flips TRUE/FALSE; UNCERTAIN stays UNCERTAIN\n            m = FOL_RE.match(txt)\n            if m:\n                tok = m.group(1).upper()\n                return {\"T\": \"TRUE\", \"TRUE\": \"TRUE\",\n                        \"F\": \"FALSE\", \"FALSE\": \"FALSE\",\n                        \"U\": \"UNCERTAIN\", \"UNCERTAIN\": \"UNCERTAIN\"}.get(tok)\n            m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n            if m:\n                tok = m.group(1).upper()\n                return \"TRUE\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"FALSE\"\n            return None\n        m = FOL_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            tok = m.group(1).upper()\n            return {\"T\": \"TRUE\", \"TRUE\": \"TRUE\",\n                    \"F\": \"FALSE\", \"FALSE\": \"FALSE\",\n                    \"U\": \"UNCERTAIN\", \"UNCERTAIN\": \"UNCERTAIN\"}.get(tok)\n        # FOL also accepts YES/NO for boolean conclusion\n        m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            tok = m.group(1).upper()\n            return \"TRUE\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"FALSE\"\n        return None\n\n    # ----- Reading (multi-hop RC) -----\n    if domain == \"reading\":\n        if variant_role == \"negation\":\n            m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n            if m:\n                tok = m.group(1).upper()\n                return \"YES\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"NO\"\n            return None\n        # MCQ -> A or B\n        m = MCQ_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            return m.group(1).upper()\n        # YES/NO boolean questions\n        m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            tok = m.group(1).upper()\n            return \"YES\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"NO\"\n        # Otherwise: return the first token (entity/day). Caller (scoring_grm)\n        # uses the parsed result for a textual comparison against the oracle.\n        first = txt.split()[0].rstrip(\".,;:?!\") if txt else \"\"\n        return first if first else None\n\n    # ----- Arithmetic -----\n    if variant_role == \"negation\":\n        m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            tok = m.group(1).upper()\n            return \"YES\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"NO\"\n        return None\n    cleaned = txt.lstrip(\"$\u00a3\u20ac\u00a5\").strip()\n    m = INT_RE.match(cleaned)\n    if m:\n        try:\n            return int(m.group(0))\n        except ValueError:\n            return None\n    m = INT_RE.search(txt)\n    if m:\n        try:\n            return int(m.group(0))\n        except ValueError:\n            return None\n    return None\n\n\n# ---- cost catalog ---------------------------------------------------------\n\n_PRICING: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] = {}\n_SUPPORTED: dict[str, set[str]] = {}\n\n\nasync def _load_catalog(session: aiohttp.ClientSession) -> None:\n    global _PRICING\n    if _PRICING:\n        return\n    try:\n        async with session.get(\n            \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models\",\n            timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=30),\n        ) as resp:\n            data = await resp.json(content_type=None)\n            for entry in data.get(\"data\", []):\n                name = entry.get(\"id\")\n                if not name:\n                    continue\n                p = entry.get(\"pricing\") or {}\n                try:\n                    _PRICING[name] = (\n                        float(p.get(\"prompt\", 0) or 0),\n                        float(p.get(\"completion\", 0) or 0),\n                    )\n                except (TypeError, ValueError):\n                    continue\n                sp = entry.get(\"supported_parameters\") or []\n                _SUPPORTED[name.lower()] = set(sp)\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n        logger.warning(f\"Catalog fetch failed: {exc}; falling back to local prices\")\n\n\ndef compute_cost_usd(model: str, in_tok: int, out_tok: int) -> float:\n    \"\"\"USD cost for a call, using the catalog (or local fallback).\"\"\"\n    price = _PRICING.get(model)\n    if price:\n        return round(in_tok * price[0] + out_tok * price[1], 8)\n    info = DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL.get(model)\n    if info is None:\n        return 0.0\n    return round(in_tok * info[\"in_price\"] + out_tok * info[\"out_price\"], 8)\n\n\n# ---- async caller ---------------------------------------------------------\n\n@dataclass\nclass CostLedger:\n    \"\"\"Tracks cumulative spend; raises SpendExceeded past the cap.\"\"\"\n    budget_usd: float\n    warn_usd: float = 2.00\n    critical_usd: float = 2.50\n    total_spent: float = 0.0\n    spend_log: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)\n    lock: asyncio.Lock | None = None  # set after construction\n\n    def __post_init__(self):\n        if self.lock is None:\n            # asyncio.Lock requires a running loop; defer creation.\n            self.lock = None\n\n    async def _get_lock(self) -> asyncio.Lock:\n        if self.lock is None:\n            self.lock = asyncio.Lock()\n        return self.lock\n\n    async def add(self, cost: float, **meta) -> bool:\n        lock = await self._get_lock()\n        async with lock:\n            self.total_spent += cost\n            self.spend_log.append({\"ts\": time.time(), \"cost\": cost, **meta})\n            if self.total_spent >= self.budget_usd:\n                raise SpendExceeded(\n                    f\"OpenRouter spend ${self.total_spent:.4f} >= budget ${self.budget_usd:.2f}\"\n                )\n            if self.total_spent >= self.critical_usd:\n                logger.critical(f\"OpenRouter spend ${self.total_spent:.4f} >= ${self.critical_usd:.2f}\")\n            elif self.total_spent >= self.warn_usd:\n                logger.warning(f\"OpenRouter spend ${self.total_spent:.4f} >= ${self.warn_usd:.2f}\")\n            return True\n\n\nclass SpendExceeded(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the cumulative OpenRouter bill exceeds the cap.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def call_one(\n    session: aiohttp.ClientSession,\n    *,\n    model: str,\n    system: str,\n    user: str,\n    max_tokens: int = 16,\n    temperature: float = 0.0,\n    domain: str,\n    variant_role: str,\n    timeout_s: float = 60.0,\n) -> CallResult:\n    \"\"\"Make a single OpenRouter call with retries and parse the response.\"\"\"\n    headers = {\n        \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {os.environ.get('OPENROUTER_API_KEY', '')}\",\n        \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n    }\n    # Use chat/completions; for free-tier models that mandate reasoning we set\n    # reasoning.effort=\"low\" to keep them from spending the entire max_tokens\n    # budget on reasoning tokens. Paid models don't need this and would reject\n    # unknown params, so we only set it for :free models.\n    payload = {\n        \"model\": model,\n        \"max_tokens\": max_tokens,\n        \"temperature\": temperature,\n        \"messages\": [\n            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": system},\n            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": user},\n        ],\n    }\n    if model.endswith(\":free\") or \":free-\" in model:\n        payload[\"reasoning\"] = {\"effort\": \"low\"}\n    started = time.monotonic()\n    last_err: str | None = None\n\n    async def _attempt() -> CallResult:\n        nonlocal last_err\n        async with session.post(\n            API_URL,\n            json=payload,\n            headers=headers,\n            timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=timeout_s),\n        ) as resp:\n            txt = await resp.text()\n            if resp.status != 200:\n                raise OpenRouterHTTPError(resp.status, txt[:300])\n            try:\n                data = json.loads(txt)\n            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n                raise OpenRouterHTTPError(resp.status, f\"json: {exc}\") from exc\n        # ---- extract output (chat/completions format) --------------------\n        output_text = \"\"\n        try:\n            choices = data.get(\"choices\") or []\n            if choices:\n                msg = choices[0].get(\"message\") or {}\n                output_text = msg.get(\"content\") or \"\"\n        except Exception:\n            output_text = \"\"\n        # Fallbacks for non-standard layouts\n        if not output_text:\n            output_text = data.get(\"output_text\", \"\") or \"\"\n        if not output_text:\n            for item in data.get(\"output\", []) or []:\n                if item.get(\"type\") == \"message\":\n                    content = item.get(\"content\") or []\n                    if content and isinstance(content[0], dict):\n                        output_text = content[0].get(\"text\", \"\")\n                    elif isinstance(content, str):\n                        output_text = content\n        usage = data.get(\"usage\", {}) or {}\n        in_tok = int(usage.get(\"prompt_tokens\", 0) or usage.get(\"input_tokens\", 0) or 0)\n        out_tok = int(usage.get(\"completion_tokens\", 0) or usage.get(\"output_tokens\", 0) or 0)\n        cost = compute_cost_usd(model, in_tok, out_tok)\n        parsed = normalize_response(output_text, domain, variant_role)\n        return CallResult(\n            success=True,\n            response_text=output_text,\n            parsed=parsed,\n            input_tokens=in_tok,\n            output_tokens=out_tok,\n            cost_usd=cost,\n            latency_s=time.monotonic() - started,\n            raw=data,\n        )\n\n    try:\n        async for attempt in AsyncRetrying(\n            stop=stop_after_attempt(4),\n            wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=2.0, min=2.0, max=30.0),\n            retry=retry_if_exception_type((OpenRouterHTTPError, aiohttp.ClientError, asyncio.TimeoutError)),\n            reraise=True,\n        ):\n            with attempt:\n                try:\n                    return await _attempt()\n                except OpenRouterHTTPError as exc:\n                    last_err = f\"HTTP {exc.status}: {exc.body[:120]}\"\n                    if exc.status in (400, 401, 403, 404):\n                        # unrecoverable; do not retry\n                        raise\n                    if exc.status == 429:\n                        # rate limited; sleep longer than the backoff schedule\n                        wait = float(os.environ.get(\"OR_429_WAIT_S\", \"30\"))\n                        logger.warning(f\"429 from {payload['model']}: sleeping {wait:.0f}s before retry\")\n                        await asyncio.sleep(wait)\n                    raise\n    except (OpenRouterHTTPError, aiohttp.ClientError, asyncio.TimeoutError) as exc:\n        return CallResult(\n            success=False,\n            response_text=\"\",\n            parsed=None,\n            input_tokens=0,\n            output_tokens=0,\n            cost_usd=0.0,\n            latency_s=time.monotonic() - started,\n            error=str(exc)[:200] or last_err or \"unknown error\",\n        )\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n        return CallResult(\n            success=False,\n            response_text=\"\",\n            parsed=None,\n            input_tokens=0,\n            output_tokens=0,\n            cost_usd=0.0,\n            latency_s=time.monotonic() - started,\n            error=str(exc)[:200],\n        )\n\n\nclass OpenRouterHTTPError(Exception):\n    def __init__(self, status: int, body: str):\n        super().__init__(f\"HTTP {status}: {body}\")\n        self.status = status\n        self.body = body\n\n\n# ---- batch driver ---------------------------------------------------------\n\nasync def query_panel(\n    panel: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],\n    clusters: list[dict],\n    *,\n    ledger: CostLedger,\n    concurrency: int = 40,\n    log_path: Path | None = None,\n    dry_run: bool = False,\n    requests_per_minute: float = 12.0,\n) -> dict[str, list[CallResult]]:\n    \"\"\"Query every (model, cluster, variant) cell concurrently.\n\n    Returns a nested dict {model_name: [CallResult per (cluster_idx, variant)]}.\n    Each model's list has length len(clusters) * 4, indexed by ci * 4 + j\n    where j is in [0..3] for roles ['seed','paraphrase','negation','<4th>'].\n\n    A global token-bucket rate limiter enforces `requests_per_minute` calls\n    across the entire sweep so that we stay below OpenRouter's free-tier\n    per-minute quota even when the per-request concurrency is high.\n    \"\"\"\n    # Build the list of work items deterministically.\n    # Flat layout: model -> list index aligned with the cluster order.\n    work: list[tuple[str, int, int, str, str, str]] = []\n    for m in panel:\n        for ci, c in enumerate(clusters):\n            for j, (role, variant) in enumerate(c[\"variants\"].items()):\n                domain = c[\"domain\"]\n                sys_msg = _system_message(domain, role)\n                work.append((m, ci, j, role, variant[\"question\"], domain, sys_msg))\n\n    results: dict[str, list[CallResult | None]] = {\n        m: [None] * (len(clusters) * 4) for m in panel\n    }\n    sem = asyncio.Semaphore(concurrency)\n\n    # Token-bucket rate limiter: at any moment we hold at most `bucket_capacity`\n    # tokens; one token is added every `interval` seconds. To avoid holding the\n    # lock across an `asyncio.sleep`, the consume helper returns a future that\n    # resolves only when a token is available \u2014 and a single background task\n    # refills the bucket.\n    rpm = max(1.0, float(requests_per_minute))\n    interval = 60.0 / rpm\n    bucket_capacity = max(1.0, rpm)\n    bucket_state = {\n        \"tokens\": bucket_capacity,\n        \"last\": time.monotonic(),\n        \"waiters\": [],  # list of asyncio.Event per waiter\n    }\n    bucket_lock = asyncio.Lock()\n\n    async def _refill():\n        while True:\n            await asyncio.sleep(interval)\n            async with bucket_lock:\n                now = time.monotonic()\n                elapsed = now - bucket_state[\"last\"]\n                refill = elapsed / interval\n                if refill >= 1.0:\n                    add = int(refill)\n                    bucket_state[\"tokens\"] = min(bucket_capacity, bucket_state[\"tokens\"] + add)\n                    bucket_state[\"last\"] += add * interval\n                # Wake up as many waiters as we have tokens for\n                while bucket_state[\"waiters\"] and bucket_state[\"tokens\"] >= 1.0:\n                    bucket_state[\"tokens\"] -= 1.0\n                    ev = bucket_state[\"waiters\"].pop(0)\n                    ev.set()\n\n    async def _consume():\n        async with bucket_lock:\n            if bucket_state[\"tokens\"] >= 1.0:\n                bucket_state[\"tokens\"] -= 1.0\n                return\n            ev = asyncio.Event()\n            bucket_state[\"waiters\"].append(ev)\n        # Block until the refill task wakes us\n        await ev.wait()\n\n    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:\n        # Skip the catalog fetch \u2014 we use local DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL prices.\n        logger.info(\"Session opened; skipping catalog fetch (using local prices)\")\n\n        if log_path is not None:\n            log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n            log_f = log_path.open(\"w\")\n        else:\n            log_f = None\n\n        async def _one(model: str, ci: int, j: int, role: str, q: str, domain: str, sys_msg: str, dry_rng=None):\n            if not dry_run and (model.endswith(\":free\") or \":free-\" in model):\n                await _consume()\n            async with sem:\n                if dry_run:\n                    # Produce a deterministic but non-degenerate response. For\n                    # the smoke test we want the GRM to see a spread of\n                    # coherence scores so it can be fitted. Each model gets a\n                    # different \"ability\" via the per-model correctness prob.\n                    rng = dry_rng or random.Random(hash((model, ci, j)) & 0xFFFFFFFF)\n                    correctness = {\n                        \"openai/gpt-4o-mini\": 0.85,\n                        \"openai/gpt-4.1-mini\": 0.86,\n                        \"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5\": 0.78,\n                        \"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4\": 0.90,\n                        \"google/gemini-2.5-flash\": 0.86,\n                        \"meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct\": 0.55,\n                        \"meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct\": 0.88,\n                        \"meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct\": 0.45,\n                        \"qwen/qwen-2.5-7b-instruct\": 0.65,\n                        \"qwen/qwen-2.5-72b-instruct\": 0.87,\n                        \"mistralai/mistral-small-24b-instruct-2501\": 0.50,\n                        \"mistralai/mistral-large-2407\": 0.80,\n                        \"mistralai/ministral-8b-2512\": 0.50,\n                        \"deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1\": 0.89,\n                        \"google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it\": 0.52,\n                    }.get(model, 0.6)\n                    is_correct = rng.random() < correctness\n                    text, parsed = _dry_run_response(rng, domain, role, is_correct)\n                    res = CallResult(\n                        success=parsed is not None,\n                        response_text=text or \"PARSE_FAIL\",\n                        parsed=parsed,\n                        input_tokens=120,\n                        output_tokens=4,\n                        cost_usd=0.0001,\n                        latency_s=0.0,\n                    )\n                else:\n                    res = await call_one(\n                        session,\n                        model=model,\n                        system=sys_msg,\n                        user=q,\n                        domain=domain,\n                        variant_role=role,\n                        max_tokens=16,\n                    )\n                await ledger.add(res.cost_usd, model=model, ci=ci, role=role)\n                if log_f is not None:\n                    log_f.write(json.dumps({\n                        \"model\": model,\n                        \"ci\": ci,\n                        \"j\": j,\n                        \"role\": role,\n                        \"q\": q[:200],\n                        \"ok\": res.success,\n                        \"parsed\": res.parsed if res.parsed is not None else str(res.error),\n                        \"in_tok\": res.input_tokens,\n                        \"out_tok\": res.output_tokens,\n                        \"cost_usd\": res.cost_usd,\n                        \"latency_s\": res.latency_s,\n                    }) + \"\\n\")\n                results[model][ci * 4 + j] = res\n\n        tasks = [_one(*w) for w in work]\n        refill_task = asyncio.create_task(_refill())\n        try:\n            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=False)\n        finally:\n            refill_task.cancel()\n\n        if log_f is not None:\n            log_f.close()\n    # Cast None -> failure marker (shouldn't happen, but be defensive)\n    final: dict[str, list[CallResult]] = {}\n    for m, recs in results.items():\n        final[m] = [\n            r if r is not None else CallResult(\n                success=False, response_text=\"\", parsed=None,\n                input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, cost_usd=0.0,\n                latency_s=0.0, error=\"missing_response\",\n            )\n            for r in recs\n        ]\n    return final\n\n\ndef _dry_run_response(rng: random.Random, domain: str, role: str, response_text: str\n    parsed: str | int | None\n    input_tokens: int\n    output_tokens: int\n    cost_usd: float\n    latency_s: float\n    error: str | None = None\n    raw: dict | None = None\n\n\n# ---- response normalization ------------------------------------------------\n#\n# v2 domains:\n#   logic        : V / I  (valid / invalid syllogism)\n#   arithmetic   : integer answer, or YES/NO on negation\n#   reading      : YES/NO (boolean), entity/day, or 2-way MCQ \"A\"/\"B\"\n#   fol          : TRUE / FALSE / UNCERTAIN\nLOGIC_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*(V|I|v|i)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\nINT_RE = re.compile(r\"-?\\d+\")\nYESNO_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*(YES|NO|Y|N|TRUE|FALSE|T|F)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\nFOL_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*(TRUE|FALSE|UNCERTAIN|T|F|U)\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\nMCQ_RE = re.compile(r\"^\\s*([AB])\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\n\n\ndef normalize_response(text: str, domain: str, variant_role: str) -> str | int | None:\n    \"\"\"Pull the first canonical token from a (possibly chatty) LLM reply.\n\n    Domains:\n      logic      : V or I (syllogism validity)\n      arithmetic : int (seed/paraphrase/inverse), YES/NO (negation)\n      reading    : YES/NO (boolean), A/B (MCQ), or surface entity/day string\n      fol        : TRUE / FALSE / UNCERTAIN\n    \"\"\"\n    if text is None:\n        return None\n    txt = text.strip()\n    if not txt:\n        return None\n\n    # ----- Logic -----\n    if variant_role == \"negation\" and domain == \"logic\":\n        m = LOGIC_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            return m.group(1).upper()\n        return None\n    if domain == \"logic\":\n        m = LOGIC_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            return m.group(1).upper()\n        return None\n\n    # ----- FOL -----\n    if domain == \"fol\":\n        if variant_role == \"negation\":\n            # negation flips TRUE/FALSE; UNCERTAIN stays UNCERTAIN\n            m = FOL_RE.match(txt)\n            if m:\n                tok = m.group(1).upper()\n                return {\"T\": \"TRUE\", \"TRUE\": \"TRUE\",\n                        \"F\": \"FALSE\", \"FALSE\": \"FALSE\",\n                        \"U\": \"UNCERTAIN\", \"UNCERTAIN\": \"UNCERTAIN\"}.get(tok)\n            m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n            if m:\n                tok = m.group(1).upper()\n                return \"TRUE\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"FALSE\"\n            return None\n        m = FOL_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            tok = m.group(1).upper()\n            return {\"T\": \"TRUE\", \"TRUE\": \"TRUE\",\n                    \"F\": \"FALSE\", \"FALSE\": \"FALSE\",\n                    \"U\": \"UNCERTAIN\", \"UNCERTAIN\": \"UNCERTAIN\"}.get(tok)\n        # FOL also accepts YES/NO for boolean conclusion\n        m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            tok = m.group(1).upper()\n            return \"TRUE\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"FALSE\"\n        return None\n\n    # ----- Reading (multi-hop RC) -----\n    if domain == \"reading\":\n        if variant_role == \"negation\":\n            m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n            if m:\n                tok = m.group(1).upper()\n                return \"YES\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"NO\"\n            return None\n        # MCQ -> A or B\n        m = MCQ_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            return m.group(1).upper()\n        # YES/NO boolean questions\n        m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            tok = m.group(1).upper()\n            return \"YES\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"NO\"\n        # Otherwise: return the first token (entity/day). Caller (scoring_grm)\n        # uses the parsed result for a textual comparison against the oracle.\n        first = txt.split()[0].rstrip(\".,;:?!\") if txt else \"\"\n        return first if first else None\n\n    # ----- Arithmetic -----\n    if variant_role == \"negation\":\n        m = YESNO_RE.match(txt)\n        if m:\n            tok = m.group(1).upper()\n            return \"YES\" if tok in {\"YES\", \"Y\", \"TRUE\", \"T\"} else \"NO\"\n        return None\n    cleaned = txt.lstrip(\"$\u00a3\u20ac\u00a5\").strip()\n    m = INT_RE.match(cleaned)\n    if m:\n        try:\n            return int(m.group(0))\n        except ValueError:\n            return None\n    m = INT_RE.search(txt)\n    if m:\n        try:\n            return int(m.group(0))\n        except ValueError:\n            return None\n    return None\n\n\n# ---- cost catalog ---------------------------------------------------------\n\n_PRICING: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] = {}\n_SUPPORTED: dict[str, set[str]] = {}\n\n\nasync def _load_catalog(session: aiohttp.ClientSession) -> None:\n    global _PRICING\n    if _PRICING:\n        return\n    try:\n        async with session.get(\n            \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models\",\n            timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=30),\n        ) as resp:\n            data = await resp.json(content_type=None)\n            for entry in data.get(\"data\", []):\n                name = entry.get(\"id\")\n                if not name:\n                    continue\n                p = entry.get(\"pricing\") or {}\n                try:\n                    _PRICING[name] = (\n                        float(p.get(\"prompt\", 0) or 0),\n                        float(p.get(\"completion\", 0) or 0),\n                    )\n                except (TypeError, ValueError):\n                    continue\n                sp = entry.get(\"supported_parameters\") or []\n                _SUPPORTED[name.lower()] = set(sp)\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n        logger.warning(f\"Catalog fetch failed: {exc}; falling back to local prices\")\n\n\ndef compute_cost_usd(model: str, in_tok: int, out_tok: int) -> float:\n    \"\"\"USD cost for a call, using the catalog (or local fallback).\"\"\"\n    price = _PRICING.get(model)\n    if price:\n        return round(in_tok * price[0] + out_tok * price[1], 8)\n    info = DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL.get(model)\n    if info is None:\n        return 0.0\n    return round(in_tok * info[\"in_price\"] + out_tok * info[\"out_price\"], 8)\n\n\n# ---- async caller ---------------------------------------------------------\n\n@dataclass\nclass CostLedger:\n    \"\"\"Tracks cumulative spend; raises SpendExceeded past the cap.\"\"\"\n    budget_usd: float\n    warn_usd: float = 2.00\n    critical_usd: float = 2.50\n    total_spent: float = 0.0\n    spend_log: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)\n    lock: asyncio.Lock | None = None  # set after construction\n\n    def __post_init__(self):\n        if self.lock is None:\n            # asyncio.Lock requires a running loop; defer creation.\n            self.lock = None\n\n    async def _get_lock(self) -> asyncio.Lock:\n        if self.lock is None:\n            self.lock = asyncio.Lock()\n        return self.lock\n\n    async def add(self, cost: float, **meta) -> bool:\n        lock = await self._get_lock()\n        async with lock:\n            self.total_spent += cost\n            self.spend_log.append({\"ts\": time.time(), \"cost\": cost, **meta})\n            if self.total_spent >= self.budget_usd:\n                raise SpendExceeded(\n                    f\"OpenRouter spend ${self.total_spent:.4f} >= budget ${self.budget_usd:.2f}\"\n                )\n            if self.total_spent >= self.critical_usd:\n                logger.critical(f\"OpenRouter spend ${self.total_spent:.4f} >= ${self.critical_usd:.2f}\")\n            elif self.total_spent >= self.warn_usd:\n                logger.warning(f\"OpenRouter spend ${self.total_spent:.4f} >= ${self.warn_usd:.2f}\")\n            return True\n\n\nclass SpendExceeded(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the cumulative OpenRouter bill exceeds the cap.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def call_one(\n    session: aiohttp.ClientSession,\n    *,\n    model: str,\n    system: str,\n    user: str,\n    max_tokens: int = 16,\n    temperature: float = 0.0,\n    domain: str,\n    variant_role: str,\n    timeout_s: float = 60.0,\n) -> CallResult:\n    \"\"\"Make a single OpenRouter call with retries and parse the response.\"\"\"\n    headers = {\n        \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {os.environ.get('OPENROUTER_API_KEY', '')}\",\n        \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n    }\n    # Use chat/completions; for free-tier models that mandate reasoning we set\n    # reasoning.effort=\"low\" to keep them from spending the entire max_tokens\n    # budget on reasoning tokens. Paid models don't need this and would reject\n    # unknown params, so we only set it for :free models.\n    payload = {\n        \"model\": model,\n        \"max_tokens\": max_tokens,\n        \"temperature\": temperature,\n        \"messages\": [\n            {\"role\": \"system\", \"content\": system},\n            {\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": user},\n        ],\n    }\n    if model.endswith(\":free\") or \":free-\" in model:\n        payload[\"reasoning\"] = {\"effort\": \"low\"}\n    started = time.monotonic()\n    last_err: str | None = None\n\n    async def _attempt() -> CallResult:\n        nonlocal last_err\n        async with session.post(\n            API_URL,\n            json=payload,\n            headers=headers,\n            timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=timeout_s),\n        ) as resp:\n            txt = await resp.text()\n            if resp.status != 200:\n                raise OpenRouterHTTPError(resp.status, txt[:300])\n            try:\n                data = json.loads(txt)\n            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n                raise OpenRouterHTTPError(resp.status, f\"json: {exc}\") from exc\n        # ---- extract output (chat/completions format) --------------------\n        output_text = \"\"\n        try:\n            choices = data.get(\"choices\") or []\n            if choices:\n                msg = choices[0].get(\"message\") or {}\n                output_text = msg.get(\"content\") or \"\"\n        except Exception:\n            output_text = \"\"\n        # Fallbacks for non-standard layouts\n        if not output_text:\n            output_text = data.get(\"output_text\", \"\") or \"\"\n        if not output_text:\n            for item in data.get(\"output\", []) or []:\n                if item.get(\"type\") == \"message\":\n                    content = item.get(\"content\") or []\n                    if content and isinstance(content[0], dict):\n                        output_text = content[0].get(\"text\", \"\")\n                    elif isinstance(content, str):\n                        output_text = content\n        usage = data.get(\"usage\", {}) or {}\n        in_tok = int(usage.get(\"prompt_tokens\", 0) or usage.get(\"input_tokens\", 0) or 0)\n        out_tok = int(usage.get(\"completion_tokens\", 0) or usage.get(\"output_tokens\", 0) or 0)\n        cost = compute_cost_usd(model, in_tok, out_tok)\n        parsed = normalize_response(output_text, domain, variant_role)\n        return CallResult(\n            success=True,\n            response_text=output_text,\n            parsed=parsed,\n            input_tokens=in_tok,\n            output_tokens=out_tok,\n            cost_usd=cost,\n            latency_s=time.monotonic() - started,\n            raw=data,\n        )\n\n    try:\n        async for attempt in AsyncRetrying(\n            stop=stop_after_attempt(4),\n            wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=2.0, min=2.0, max=30.0),\n            retry=retry_if_exception_type((OpenRouterHTTPError, aiohttp.ClientError, asyncio.TimeoutError)),\n            reraise=True,\n        ):\n            with attempt:\n                try:\n                    return await _attempt()\n                except OpenRouterHTTPError as exc:\n                    last_err = f\"HTTP {exc.status}: {exc.body[:120]}\"\n                    if exc.status in (400, 401, 403, 404):\n                        # unrecoverable; do not retry\n                        raise\n                    if exc.status == 429:\n                        # rate limited; sleep longer than the backoff schedule\n                        wait = float(os.environ.get(\"OR_429_WAIT_S\", \"30\"))\n                        logger.warning(f\"429 from {payload['model']}: sleeping {wait:.0f}s before retry\")\n                        await asyncio.sleep(wait)\n                    raise\n    except (OpenRouterHTTPError, aiohttp.ClientError, asyncio.TimeoutError) as exc:\n        return CallResult(\n            success=False,\n            response_text=\"\",\n            parsed=None,\n            input_tokens=0,\n            output_tokens=0,\n            cost_usd=0.0,\n            latency_s=time.monotonic() - started,\n            error=str(exc)[:200] or last_err or \"unknown error\",\n        )\n    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001\n        return CallResult(\n            success=False,\n            response_text=\"\",\n            parsed=None,\n            input_tokens=0,\n            output_tokens=0,\n            cost_usd=0.0,\n            latency_s=time.monotonic() - started,\n            error=str(exc)[:200],\n        )\n\n\nclass OpenRouterHTTPError(Exception):\n    def __init__(self, status: int, body: str):\n        super().__init__(f\"HTTP {status}: {body}\")\n        self.status = status\n        self.body = body\n\n\n# ---- batch driver ---------------------------------------------------------\n\nasync def query_panel(\n    panel: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],\n    clusters: list[dict],\n    *,\n    ledger: CostLedger,\n    concurrency: int = 40,\n    log_path: Path | None = None,\n    dry_run: bool = False,\n    requests_per_minute: float = 12.0,\n) -> dict[str, list[CallResult]]:\n    \"\"\"Query every (model, cluster, variant) cell concurrently.\n\n    Returns a nested dict {model_name: [CallResult per (cluster_idx, variant)]}.\n    Each model's list has length len(clusters) * 4, indexed by ci * 4 + j\n    where j is in [0..3] for roles ['seed','paraphrase','negation','<4th>'].\n\n    A global token-bucket rate limiter enforces `requests_per_minute` calls\n    across the entire sweep so that we stay below OpenRouter's free-tier\n    per-minute quota even when the per-request concurrency is high.\n    \"\"\"\n    # Build the list of work items deterministically.\n    # Flat layout: model -> list index aligned with the cluster order.\n    work: list[tuple[str, int, int, str, str, str]] = []\n    for m in panel:\n        for ci, c in enumerate(clusters):\n            for j, (role, variant) in enumerate(c[\"variants\"].items()):\n                domain = c[\"domain\"]\n                sys_msg = _system_message(domain, role)\n                work.append((m, ci, j, role, variant[\"question\"], domain, sys_msg))\n\n    results: dict[str, list[CallResult | None]] = {\n        m: [None] * (len(clusters) * 4) for m in panel\n    }\n    sem = asyncio.Semaphore(concurrency)\n\n    # Token-bucket rate limiter: at any moment we hold at most `bucket_capacity`\n    # tokens; one token is added every `interval` seconds. To avoid holding the\n    # lock across an `asyncio.sleep`, the consume helper returns a future that\n    # resolves only when a token is available \u2014 and a single background task\n    # refills the bucket.\n    rpm = max(1.0, float(requests_per_minute))\n    interval = 60.0 / rpm\n    bucket_capacity = max(1.0, rpm)\n    bucket_state = {\n        \"tokens\": bucket_capacity,\n        \"last\": time.monotonic(),\n        \"waiters\": [],  # list of asyncio.Event per waiter\n    }\n    bucket_lock = asyncio.Lock()\n\n    async def _refill():\n        while True:\n            await asyncio.sleep(interval)\n            async with bucket_lock:\n                now = time.monotonic()\n                elapsed = now - bucket_state[\"last\"]\n                refill = elapsed / interval\n                if refill >= 1.0:\n                    add = int(refill)\n                    bucket_state[\"tokens\"] = min(bucket_capacity, bucket_state[\"tokens\"] + add)\n                    bucket_state[\"last\"] += add * interval\n                # Wake up as many waiters as we have tokens for\n                while bucket_state[\"waiters\"] and bucket_state[\"tokens\"] >= 1.0:\n                    bucket_state[\"tokens\"] -= 1.0\n                    ev = bucket_state[\"waiters\"].pop(0)\n                    ev.set()\n\n    async def _consume():\n        async with bucket_lock:\n            if bucket_state[\"tokens\"] >= 1.0:\n                bucket_state[\"tokens\"] -= 1.0\n                return\n            ev = asyncio.Event()\n            bucket_state[\"waiters\"].append(ev)\n        # Block until the refill task wakes us\n        await ev.wait()\n\n    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:\n        # Skip the catalog fetch \u2014 we use local DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL prices.\n        logger.info(\"Session opened; skipping catalog fetch (using local prices)\")\n\n        if log_path is not None:\n            log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n            log_f = log_path.open(\"w\")\n        else:\n            log_f = None\n\n        async def _one(model: str, ci: int, j: int, role: str, q: str, domain: str, sys_msg: str, dry_rng=None):\n            if not dry_run and (model.endswith(\":free\") or \":free-\" in model):\n                await _consume()\n            async with sem:\n                if dry_run:\n                    # Produce a deterministic but non-degenerate response. For\n                    # the smoke test we want the GRM to see a spread of\n                    # coherence scores so it can be fitted. Each model gets a\n                    # different \"ability\" via the per-model correctness prob.\n                    rng = dry_rng or random.Random(hash((model, ci, j)) & 0xFFFFFFFF)\n                     \"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4\": 0.90,\n                        \"google/gemini-2.5-flash\": 0.86,\n                        \"meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct\": 0.55,\n                \"mistralai/ministral-8b-2512\": 0.50,\n                        \"deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1\": 0.89,\n                        \"google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it\": 0.52,\n                    }.get(model, 0.6)\n                    is_correct = rng.random() < correctness\n                    text, parsed = _dry_run_response(rng, domain, role, is_correct)\n                    res = CallResult(\n                        success=parsed is not None,\n                        response_text=text or \"PARSE_FAIL\",\n                        parsed=parsed,\n                        input_tokens=120,\n                        output_tokens=4,\n                        cost_usd=0.0001,\n                        latency_s=0.0,\n                    )\n                else:\n domain=domain,\n                        variant_role=role,\n                        max_tokens=16,\n                    )\n                await ledger.add(res.cost_usd, model=model, ci=ci, role=role)\n                if log_f is not None:\n                    log_f.write(json.dumps({\n                        \"model\": model,\n                        \"ci\": ci,\n                        \"j\": j,\n                        \"role\": role,\n                        \"q\": q[:200],\n                        \"ok\": res.success,\n                        \"parsed\": res.parsed if res.parsed is not None else str(res.error),\n                        \"in_tok\": res.input_tokens,\n                        \"out_tok\": res.output_tokens,\n                        \"cost_usd\": res.cost_usd,\n                        \"latency_s\": res.latency_s,\n                    }) + \"\\n\")\n                results[model][ci * 4 + j] = res\n\n        tasks = [_one(*w) for w in work]\n        refill_task = asyncio.create_task(_refill())\n        try:\n            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=False)\n        finally:\n            refill_task.cancel()\n\n        if log_f is not None:\n            log_f.close()\n    # Cast None -> failure marker (shouldn't happen, but be defensive)\n    final: dict[str, list[CallResult]] = {}\n    for m, recs in results.items():\n        final[m] = [\n            r if r is not None else CallResult(\n                success=False, response_text=\"\", parsed=None,\n                input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, cost_usd=0.0,\n                latency_s=0.0, error=\"missing_response\",\n            )\n            for r in recs\n        ]\n    return final\n\n\ndef _dry_run_response(rng: random.Random, domain: str, role: str, is_correct: bool):\n    \"\"\"Generate a synthetic dry-run response covering all four v2 domains.\n\n    Returns (text, parsed) where parsed is None for unparseable responses.\n    The `is_correct` flag biases whether the response matches the oracle for\n    the variant role; negation roles deliberately flip the response when the\n    model \"agrees\" with the negation.\n    \"\"\"\n    def _ok(text: str) -> bool:\n        return rng.random() < 0.95\n\n    if domain == \"logic\":\n        text = (\"V\" if rng.random() < 0.5 else \"I\") if _ok(\"\") else \"\"\n        parsed = \"V\" if text.startswith(\"V\") else (\"I\" if text.startswith(\"I\") else None)\n        if role == \"negation\" and is_correct and parsed is not None:\n            parsed = \"I\" if parsed == \"V\" else \"V\"\n        return text, parsed\n\n    if domain == \"fol\":\n        if rng.random() < 0.7:\n            choices = [\"TRUE\", \"FALSE\", \"UNCERTAIN\"]\n            text = choices[rng.randint(0, 2)]\n            parsed = text\n        else:\n            text = \"TRUE\" if rng.random() < 0.5 else \"FALSE\"\n            parsed = text\n        if role == \"negation\" and is_correct and parsed in {\"TRUE\", \"FALSE\"}:\n            parsed = \"FALSE\" if parsed == \"TRUE\" else \"TRUE\"\n        return text, parsed\n\n    if domain == \"reading\":\n        if role == \"negation\":\n            text = \"YES\" if rng.random() < 0.5 else \"NO\"\n            parsed = text\n            if is_correct:\n                # seed answer would be e.g. YES, negation answer is NO\n                parsed = \"NO\" if parsed == \"YES\" else \"YES\"\n            return text, parsed\n        # MCQ (A or B) for ~50% of dry runs; otherwise entity/string\n        if rng.random() < 0.5:\n            text = \"A\" if rng.random() < 0.5 else \"B\"\n            parsed = text\n            return text, parsed\n        # entity\n        text = \"Alice\" if rng.random() < 0.5 else \"Bob\"\n        parsed = text\n        return text, parsed\n\n    # arithmetic (default)\n    if role == \"negation\":\n        text = \"YES\" if rng.random() < 0.5 else \"NO\"\n        parsed = text\n        return text, parsed\n    n = rng.randint(2, 25)\n    text = str(n) if _ok(\"\") else \"\"\n    try:\n        parsed = int(text)\n    except ValueError:\n        parsed = None\n    return text, parsed\n\n\ndef _system_message(domain: str, role: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Per-variant system message \u2014 keeps the model's response space narrow.\"\"\"\n    if domain == \"logic\":\n        return (\n            \"You must answer with exactly one character: V if the argument is valid, \"\n            \"I if it is invalid. For negation questions, still answer V or I based on \"\n            \"the truth of the original (negated) claim. No explanation, no other text.\"\n        )\n    # arithmetic\n    if role == \"negation\":\n        return (\n            \"You must answer with exactly one word: YES or NO. \"\n            \"No explanation, no other text.\"\n        )\n    return (\n        \"You must answer with only the integer result. No explanation, \"\n        \"no other text.\"\n    )", "new_content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Async OpenRouter client used by the M-IRT pipeline.\n\nWraps aiohttp with a bounded semaphore, tenacity retries, and a per-task\ncost ledger. Returns parsed responses plus per-call token + cost info.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport json\nimport os\nimport random\nimport re\nimport time\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nimport aiohttp\nfrom loguru import logger\nfrom tenacity import (\n    AsyncRetrying,\n    retry_if_exception_type,\n    stop_after_attempt,\n    wait_exponential,\n)\n\n\nAPI_URL = \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions\"\n\n# M-IRT v2 \u2014 15-model panel spanning 5 families, closed+open, small+large.\n#\n# Panel design rationale (artifact_plan \u00a71):\n#   4 closed-source:  gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini, claude-haiku-4.5, claude-sonnet-4,\n#                     gemini-2.5-flash  (5 closed-source)\n#   8 open-weights :  llama-3.1-8b, llama-3.3-70b, llama-3.2-3b (Meta)\n#                     qwen-2.5-7b, qwen-2.5-72b (Alibaba)\n#                     mistral-small-24b, mistral-large-2407, ministral-8b (Mistral)\n#                     gemma-4-26b (Google)\n#   2 other        :  deepseek-chat-v3.1, mistral-large-2407\n# Tier mapping:\n#   high        : gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini, claude-haiku-4.5, gemini-2.5-flash,\n#                 llama-3.3-70b, qwen-2.5-72b, deepseek-chat-v3.1, mistral-large-2407\n#   mid         : mistral-small-24b, qwen-2.5-7b\n#   low         : llama-3.1-8b, ministral-8b, gemma-4-26b\n#   very-low    : llama-3.2-3b\n#   very-high   : claude-sonnet-4\n#\n# Prices are USD/token from the live OpenRouter catalog fetched 2026-09-05.\n# The panel was verified to be present in the catalog at run start.\nDEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {\n    # Closed-source\n    \"openai/gpt-4o-mini\": {\"tier\": \"high\", \"in_price\": 0.15e-6, \"out_price\": 0.60e-6},\n    \"openai/gpt-4.1-mini\": {\"tier\": \"high\", \"in_price\": 0.40e-6, \"out_price\": 1.60e-6},\n    \"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5\": {\"tier\": \"high\", \"in_price\": 1.00e-6, \"out_price\": 5.00e-6},\n    \"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4\": {\"tier\": \"very-high\", \"in_price\": 3.00e-6, \"out_price\": 15.00e-6},\n    \"google/gemini-2.5-flash\": {\"tier\": \"high\", \"in_price\": 0.30e-6, \"out_price\": 2.50e-6},\n    # Open-weights: Llama family\n    \"meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct\": {\"tier\": \"low-mid\", \"in_price\": 0.05e-6, \"out_price\": 0.08e-6},\n    \"meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct\": {\"tier\": \"high\", \"in_price\": 0.10e-6, \"out_price\": 0.32e-6},\n    \"meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct\": {\"tier\": \"very-low\", \"in_price\": 0.05e-6, \"out_price\": 0.33e-6},\n    # Open-weights: Mistral family\n    \"mistralai/mistral-small-24b-instruct-2501\": {\"tier\": \"mid\", \"in_price\": 0.05e-6, \"out_price\": 0.08e-6},\n    \"mistralai/mistral-large-2407\": {\"tier\": \"very-high\", \"in_price\": 2.00e-6, \"out_price\": 6.00e-6},\n    \"mistralai/ministral-8b-2512\": {\"tier\": \"low\", \"in_price\": 0.15e-6, \"out_price\": 0.15e-6},\n    # Open-weights: Deepseek, Gemma\n    \"deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1\": {\"tier\": \"high\", \"in_price\": 0.55e-6, \"out_price\": 1.65e-6},\n    \"google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it\": {\"tier\": \"low\", \"in_price\": 0.07e-6, \"out_price\": 0.34e-6},\n}\n\n\ndef _safe_filename(model: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Map a model id like 'google/gemma-4-31b-it:free' to a filesystem-safe\n    basename like 'google_gemma-4-31b-it_free'.\"\"\"\n    return model.replace(\"/\", \"_\").replace(\":\", \"_\").replace(\".\", \"_\")\n\n\n# Pre-validated published accuracy (HELM / MMLU) \u2014 used as the validation-A\n# baseline. llama-3.3-70b-instruct  \u2014 Meta (2024-12): MMLU 86.0%, HELM ~0.81\n#   llama-3.2-3b-instruct   \u2014 Meta (2024-09): MMLU 62.0%, HELM ~0.60\n#   qwen-2.5-7b-instruct    \u2014 Alibaba (2024-09): MMLU 70.7%, HELM ~0.69\n#   qwen-2.5-72b-instruct   \u2014 Alibaba (2024-09): MMLU 85.0%, HELM ~0.82\n#   mistral-small-24b       \u2014 Mistral AI (2025-01): MMLU 73.2%, HELM ~0.71\n# \"helm\": 0.65},\n    \"meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct\": {\"mmlu\": 0.860, \"helm\": 0.81},\n    \"meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct\": {\"mmlu\": 0.620, \"helm\": 0.60},\n
