   if u.startswith(\"N\") or u == \"FALSE\" or u == \"F\":\n            return \"NO\"\n        # Entity / day: return first token (strip punctuation)\n        first = s.split()[0].rstrip(\".,;:?!\\\"'\") if s else \"\"\n        return first if first else None\n\n    # arithmetic (default)\n    if role == \"negation\":\n        u = s.upper()\n        if u.startswith(\"Y\") or u == \"TRUE\" or u == \"T\":\n            return \"YES\"\n        if u.startswith(\"N\") or u == \"FALSE\" or u == \"F\":\n            return \"NO\"\n        return None\n    import re as _re\n    cleaned = s.lstrip(\"$\u00a3\u20ac\u00a5\").replace(\",\", \"\")\n    try:\n        return int(cleaned.split()[0])\n    except (ValueError, IndexError):\n        m = _re.search(r\"-?\\d+\", s)\n        if m:\n            try:\n                return int(m.group(0))\n            except ValueError:\n                return None\n        return None\n\n\ndef _matches_oracle(parsed, oracle_value, domain: str, role: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Score a single (model, cluster, variant) cell against the oracle.\n\n    For logic / fol negation, the oracle is \"FLIPPED\"; the caller\n    (_score_cluster) handles the actual relational flip and we return False here.\n    \"\"\"\n    if parsed is None:\n        return False\n    if domain == \"logic\":\n        if role == \"negation\":\n            return False\n        return parsed == oracle_value\n    if domain == \"fol\":\n        if role == \"negation\":\n            return False\n        return parsed == oracle_value\n    if domain == \"reading\":\n        if role == \"negation\":\n            return parsed == oracle_value\n        if oracle_value is None or parsed is None:\n            return False\n        if isinstance(oracle_value, str) and isinstance(parsed, str):\n            return oracle_value.strip().lower() == parsed.strip().lower()\n        return parsed == oracle_value\n    if role == \"negation\":\n        return parsed == oracle_value\n    try:\n        return int(parsed) == int(oracle_value)\n    except (ValueError, TypeError):\n        return False\n\n\ndef _flip_logic(label):\n    return \"I\" if label == \"V\" else \"V\"\n\n\ndef _flip_fol(label):\n    if label == \"TRUE\":\n        return \"FALSE\"\n    if label == \"FALSE\":\n        return \"TRUE\"\n    return \"UNCERTAIN\"\n\n\ndef _score_cluster(cluster, parsed_per_role):\n    \"\"\"Return per-variant flags + coherence_score in {0,1,2} for one cluster.\n\n    The fourth role (variant key not in {seed, paraphrase, negation}) varies\n    by domain: contrapositive (logic), inverse (arithmetic), distractor\n    (reading), quantifier_shift (fol). We look it up dynamically so each\n    cluster's full 4-variant set is scored.\n    \"\"\"\n    domain = cluster[\"domain\"]\n    roles = list(cluster[\"variants\"].keys())\n    ordered = [\"seed\", \"paraphrase\", \"negation\"]\n    for r in roles:\n        if r not in ordered:\n            ordered.append(r)\n\n    correct_flags = []\n    flag_details = {}\n    for role in ordered:\n        oracle_value = cluster[\"answers\"][role]\n        parsed = parsed_per_role.get(role)\n        if domain == \"logic\" and role == \"negation\":\n            seed_label = cluster[\"answers\"][\"seed\"]\n            flipped = _flip_logic(seed_label)\n            ok = parsed == flipped\n            flag_details[role] = {\"parsed\": parsed, \"oracle\": flipped, \"ok\": ok}\n            correct_flags.append(int(ok))\n        elif domain == \"fol\" and role == \"negation\":\n            seed_label = cluster[\"answers\"][\"seed\"]\n            flipped = _flip_fol(seed_label)\n            ok = parsed == flipped\n            flag_details[role] = {\"parsed\": parsed, \"oracle\": flipped, \"ok\": ok}\n            correct_flags.append(int(ok))\n        else:\n            ok = _matches_oracle(parsed, oracle_value, domain, role)\n            flag_details[role] = {\"parsed\": parsed, \"oracle\": oracle_value, \"ok\": ok}\n            correct_flags.append(int(ok))\n\n    raw = sum(correct_flags)\n    if raw >= 3:\n        score = 2\n    elif raw == 2:\n        score = 1\n    else:\n        score = 0\n    return {\n        \"raw\": raw,\n        \"score\": score,\n        \"flags\": correct_flags,\n        \"details\": flag_details,\n    }\n\n\ndef _variant_layout_for(cluster):\n    \"\"\"Return the variant role list for this cluster, in canonical order.\"\"\"\n    roles = list(cluster[\"variants\"].keys())\n    ordered = [\"seed\", \"paraphrase\", \"negation\"]\n    for r in roles:\n        if r not in ordered:\n            ordered.append(r)\n    return ordered\n\n\ndef score_all(clusters, responses, panel):\n    \"\"\"Compute the (M, I) ordinal response matrix and per-model summaries.\"\"\"\n    M = len(panel)\n    I = len(clusters)\n    score_mat = np.zeros((M, I), dtype=np.int8)\n    raw_mat = np.zeros((M, I), dtype=np.int8)\n    per_model_summary = {}\n    per_example = []\n\n    for mi, model in enumerate(panel):\n        records = responses[model]\n        static_correct = 0\n        static_total = 0\n        sum_score = 0\n        sum_raw = 0\n        for ci, cluster in enumerate(clusters):\n            idx = ci * 4\n            variant_layout = _variant_layout_for(cluster)\n            parsed_per_role = {}\n            for j, role in enumerate(variant_layout):\n                rec = records[idx + j] if (idx + j) < len(records) else None\n                if rec is None:\n                    parsed_per_role[role] = None\n                    continue\n                parsed_per_role[role] = parse_for_domain(rec.parsed, cluster[\"domain\"], role)\n\n            scored = _score_cluster(cluster, parsed_per_role)\n            score_mat[mi, ci] = scored[\"score\"]\n            raw_mat[mi, ci] = scored[\"raw\"]\n\n            seed_rec = records[idx] if idx < len(records) else None\n            seed_parsed = parse_for_domain(\n                seed_rec.parsed if seed_rec else None,\n                cluster[\"domain\"], \"seed\"\n            )\n            seed_ok = _matches_oracle(seed_parsed, cluster[\"answers\"][\"seed\"],\n                                      cluster[\"domain\"], \"seed\")\n            static_correct += int(seed_ok)\n            static_total += 1\n            sum_score += scored[\"score\"]\n            sum_raw += scored[\"raw\"]\n            per_example.append({\n                \"model\": model,\n                \"cluster_id\": cluster[\"cluster_id\"],\n                \"domain\": cluster[\"domain\"],\n                \"score\": int(scored[\"score\"]),\n                \"raw\": int(scored[\"raw\"]),\n                \"seed_ok\": int(seed_ok),\n                \"details\": {k: {\"parsed\": (str(v[\"parsed\"]) if not isinstance(v[\"parsed\"], (str, int))\n                                            and v[\"parsed\"] is not None else v[\"parsed\"]),\n                                \"oracle\": str(v[\"oracle\"]),\n                                \"ok\": int(v[\"ok\"])}\n                            for k, v in scored[\"details\"].items()},\n            })\n        per_model_summary[model] = {\n            \"mean_ordinal_score\": float(sum_score / max(1, I)),\n            \"mean_raw_correct\": float(sum_raw / max(1, I)),\n            \"static_acc_on_seeds\": float(static_correct / max(1, static_total)),\n        }\n\n    return {\n        \"matrix\": score_mat,\n        \"raw_matrix\": raw_mat,\n        \"per_model\": per_model_summary,\n        \"per_example\": per_example,\n    }\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 4: GRM fitting\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@dataclass\nclass GRMResult:\n    ability: np.ndarray\n    discrimination: np.ndarray\n    difficulty: np.ndarray\n    convergence_iters: int\n    aic: float\n    bic: float\n    n_categories: int\n    items_dropped: list\n    fit_success: bool = True\n\n\ndef _collapse_to_K(raw_matrix, K):\n    \"\"\"Collapse the {0..4} raw count matrix into K ordinal categories.\n\n    K=2: 0 vs >=1 (2PL collapse)\n    K=3: 0-1 vs 2 vs >=3 (iter-1 default)\n    K=4: 0 vs 1 vs 2 vs >=3 (recommended by research_report)\n    K=5: 0 vs 1 vs 2 vs 3 vs >=4 (extra gradation)\n    \"\"\"\n    raw = np.asarray(raw_matrix, dtype=int)\n    if K == 2:\n        out = (raw >= 1).astype(np.int8)\n    elif K == 3:\n        out = np.where(raw >= 3, 2, np.where(raw >= 2, 1, 0)).astype(np.int8)\n    elif K == 4:\n        out = np.where(raw >= 3, 3,\n                       np.where(raw == 2, 2,\n                                np.where(raw == 1, 1, 0))).astype(np.int8)\n    elif K == 5:\n        out = np.where(raw >= 4, 4,\n                       np.where(raw == 3, 3,\n                                np.where(raw == 2, 2,\n                                         np.where(raw == 1, 1, 0)))).astype(np.int8)\n    else:\n        raise ValueError(f\"K must be in {{2,3,4,5}}, got {K}\")\n    return out\n\n\ndef fit_grm(score_matrix, *, max_iter: int = 200) -> GRMResult:\n    \"\"\"Fit a Graded Response Model via girth.grm_mml.\n\n    Score matrix is (M, I) with values in {0, 1, ..., K-1}.\n    girth expects (I, M) \u2014 items x persons \u2014 so we transpose.\n    \"\"\"\n    import girth\n\n    M, I = score_matrix.shape\n    K = int(score_matrix.max()) + 1\n    logger.info(f\"Fitting GRM on ({I} items, {M} persons, {K} categories)\")\n\n    X = score_matrix.T.astype(int)\n    X = np.clip(X, 0, K - 1)\n    if X.min() == X.max():\n        logger.warning(\"Score matrix has zero variance; GRM cannot be fit.\")\n        return GRMResult(\n            ability=np.zeros(M),\n            discrimination=np.zeros(I),\n            difficulty=np.zeros((I, max(1, K - 1))),\n            convergence_iters=0,\n            aic=float(\"nan\"),\n            bic=float(\"nan\"),\n            n_categories=K,\n            items_dropped=list(range(I)),\n            fit_success=False,\n        )\n\n    try:\n        res = girth.grm_mml(X)\n        ability = np.asarray(res[\"Ability\"], dtype=float)\n        discrimination = np.asarray(res[\"Discrimination\"], dtype=float)\n        difficulty = np.asarray(res[\"Difficulty\"], dtype=float)\n        fit_success = True\n    except Exception as exc:\n        logger.warning(f\"GRM fit failed: {exc}\")\n        return GRMResult(\n            ability=np.zeros(M),\n            discrimination=np.ones(I),\n            difficulty=np.zeros((I, max(1, K - 1))),\n            convergence_iters=0,\n            aic=float(\"nan\"),\n            bic=float(\"nan\"),\n            n_categories=K,\n            items_dropped=list(range(I)),\n            fit_success=False,\n        )\n\n    items_dropped = [int(i) for i, a in enumerate(discrimination)\n                     if not np.isfinite(a) or a <= 0]\n    discrimination = np.where(np.isfinite(discrimination) & (discrimination > 0),\n                              discrimination, 1e-3)\n\n    aic_raw = res.get(\"AIC\", float(\"nan\"))\n    bic_raw = res.get(\"BIC\", float(\"nan\"))\n    if isinstance(aic_raw, dict):\n        aic_raw = aic_raw.get(\"final\", float(\"nan\"))\n    if isinstance(bic_raw, dict):\n        bic_raw = bic_raw.get(\"final\", float(\"nan\"))\n    aic = float(aic_raw) if aic_raw is not None else float(\"nan\")\n    bic = float(bic_raw) if bic_raw is not None else float(\"nan\")\n    return GRMResult(\n        ability=ability,\n        discrimination=discrimination,\n        difficulty=difficulty,\n        convergence_iters=int(getattr(res, \"iterations\", 0) or 0),\n        aic=aic,\n        bic=bic,\n        n_categories=K,\n        items_dropped=items_dropped,\n        fit_success=fit_success,\n    )\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 4.5: K-ablation and LOO stability (v2 new)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef grm_k_ablation(raw_matrix, panel,\n                   K_list=(2, 3, 4, 5),\n                   published_mmlu=None,\n                   published_helm=None):\n    \"\"\"Fit the GRM with K in {2,3,4,5} on the same (M, I) raw score matrix.\n\n    For each K, record:\n      - n_categories, AIC, BIC\n      - Pearson r against MMLU, Pearson r against HELM, Spearman rho, Kendall tau\n    The 'recommended K' is the one with the lowest BIC; report it explicitly.\n    \"\"\"\n    from scipy.stats import spearmanr, kendalltau\n\n    out = {}\n    for K in K_list:\n        score = _collapse_to_K(raw_matrix, K)\n        grm = fit_grm(score.astype(np.int8))\n        theta = np.asarray(grm.ability, dtype=float)\n        try:\n            if published_mmlu is not None and len(np.unique(theta)) > 1:\n                r_mmlu = float(np.corrcoef(theta, published_mmlu)[0, 1])\n                rho_mmlu = float(spearmanr(theta, published_mmlu).statistic)\n                tau_mmlu = float(kendalltau(theta, published_mmlu).statistic)\n            else:\n                r_mmlu = rho_mmlu = tau_mmlu = float(\"nan\")\n            if published_helm is not None and len(np.unique(theta)) > 1:\n                r_helm = float(np.corrcoef(theta, published_helm)[0, 1])\n                rho_helm = float(spearmanr(theta, published_helm).statistic)\n                tau_helm = float(kendalltau(theta, published_helm).statistic)\n            else:\n                r_helm = rho_helm = tau_helm = float(\"nan\")\n        except Exception as exc:\n            logger.warning(f\"K={K} correlation failed: {exc}\")\n            r_mmlu = r_helm = rho_mmlu = tau_mmlu = rho_helm = tau_helm = float(\"nan\")\n\n        n_items = int(raw_matrix.shape[1])\n        n_persons = int(raw_matrix.shape[0])\n        # Thresholds: (K-1)*n_items; discriminations: n_items; abilities: n_persons\n        n_params = (K - 1) * n_items + n_items + n_persons\n        out[f\"K={K}\"] = {\n            \"n_categories\": int(grm.n_categories),\n            \"n_params\": n_params,\n            \"log_likelihood\": float(\"nan\"),  # girth doesn't expose directly\n            \"aic\": float(grm.aic) if grm.aic is not None and not math.isnan(grm.aic) else float(\"nan\"),\n            \"bic\": float(grm.bic) if grm.bic is not None and not math.isnan(grm.bic) else float(\"nan\"),\n            \"r_mmlu\": r_mmlu,\n            \"r_helm\": r_helm,\n            \"spearman_rho_mmlu\": rho_mmlu,\n            \"kendall_tau_mmlu\": tau_mmlu,\n            \"spearman_rho_helm\": rho_helm,\n            \"kendall_tau_helm\": tau_helm,\n            \"theta\": [float(t) for t in theta],\n            \"fit_success\": bool(grm.fit_success),\n            \"convergence_iters\": int(grm.convergence_iters),\n        }\n    valid = {k: v for k, v in out.items()\n             if v[\"fit_success\"] and not math.isnan(v[\"bic\"])}\n    if valid:\n        recommended_K = min(valid, key=lambda k: valid[k][\"bic\"])\n    else:\n        recommended_K = \"K=3\"\n    out[\"recommended_K\"] = recommended_K\n    out[\"n_models\"] = int(raw_matrix.shape[0])\n    out[\"n_clusters\"] = int(raw_matrix.shape[1])\n    return out\n\n\ndef loo_theta_stability(raw_matrix, panel, K=3):\n    \"\"\"Leave-one-out stability analysis.\n\n    For each of the M models, drop that model's row, refit the GRM with\n    K categories, and record the Pearson r of the remaining (M-1) thetas\n    vs the full-M thetas (excluding the held-out model itself).\n    \"\"\"\n    score_full = _collapse_to_K(raw_matrix, K)\n    grm_full = fit_grm(score_full.astype(np.int8))\n    full_theta = np.asarray(grm_full.ability, dtype=float)\n    M = raw_matrix.shape[0]\n    per_model_delta = []\n    held_in_rs = []\n    for m in range(M):\n        idx = [i for i in range(M) if i != m]\n        sub = raw_matrix[idx, :]\n        sub_score = _collapse_to_K(sub, K)\n        grm_sub = fit_grm(sub_score.astype(np.int8))\n        sub_theta = np.asarray(grm_sub.ability, dtype=float)\n        comp_theta = full_theta[idx]\n        if len(sub_theta) >= 3 and np.std(sub_theta) > 0 and np.std(comp_theta) > 0:\n            r = float(np.corrcoef(sub_theta, comp_theta)[0, 1])\n        else:\n            r = float(\"nan\")\n        held_in_rs.append(r)\n        max_abs_delta = float(np.max(np.abs(sub_theta - comp_theta)))\n        per_model_delta.append({\n            \"model\": panel[m],\n            \"loo_pearson_r_vs_full_minus_self\": r,\n            \"loo_max_abs_delta_theta\": max_abs_delta,\n        })\n    valid_rs = [r for r in held_in_rs if not math.isnan(r)]\n    return {\n        \"K\": int(K),\n        \"per_model\": per_model_delta,\n        \"mean_loo_r\": float(np.mean(valid_rs)) if valid_rs else float(\"nan\"),\n        \"min_loo_r\": float(np.min(valid_rs)) if valid_rs else float(\"nan\"),\n        \"max_abs_loo_delta\": float(max(d[\"loo_max_abs_delta_theta\"] for d in per_model_delta)),\n    }\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 5: Validation A \u2014 correlation with published accuracy\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef validate_a(grm, panel):\n    \"\"\"Compute Pearson r between theta_j and published MMLU accuracy.\"\"\"\n    mmlu = np.array([PUBLISHED_ACCURACY[m][\"mmlu\"] for m in panel], dtype=float)\n    helm = np.array([PUBLISHED_ACCURACY[m][\"helm\"] for m in panel], dtype=float)\n    theta = np.asarray(grm.ability, dtype=float)\n\n    def pearson(x, y):\n        if len(x) < 3 or np.std(x) == 0 or np.std(y) == 0:\n            return float(\"nan\")\n        return float(np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1])\n\n    r_mmlu = pearson(theta, mmlu)\n    r_helm = pearson(theta, helm)\n\n    from scipy.stats import spearmanr, kendalltau\n    try:\n        rho_mmlu = float(spearmanr(theta, mmlu).statistic)\n        tau_mmlu = float(kendalltau(theta, mmlu).statistic)\n        rho_helm = float(spearmanr(theta, helm).statistic)\n        tau_helm = float(kendalltau(theta, helm).statistic)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        logger.warning(f\"Spearman/Kendall failed: {exc}\")\n        rho_mmlu = tau_mmlu = rho_helm = tau_helm = float(\"nan\")\n\n    def ci(x, y, n_boot=10000, seed=0):\n        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        rs = []\n        n = len(x)\n        for _ in range(n_boot):\n            ix = rng.integers(0, n, size=n)\n            xx, yy = x[ix], y[ix]\n            if np.std(xx) == 0 or np.std(yy) == 0:\n                continue\n            rs.append(pearson(xx, yy))\n        if not rs:\n            return (float(\"nan\"), float(\"nan\"))\n        lo, hi = np.percentile(rs, [2.5, 97.5])\n        return (float(lo), float(hi))\n\n    ci_mmlu = ci(theta, mmlu)\n    ci_helm = ci(theta, helm)\n\n    return {\n        \"r_mmlu\": r_mmlu,\n        \"r_helm\": r_helm,\n        \"spearman_rho_mmlu\": rho_mmlu,\n        \"kendall_tau_mmlu\": tau_mmlu,\n        \"spearman_rho_helm\": rho_helm,\n        \"kendall_tau_helm\": tau_helm,\n        \"ci_mmlu\": ci_mmlu,\n        \"ci_helm\": ci_helm,\n        \"theta_ranking\": sorted(\n            [{\"model\": m, \"theta\": float(t), \"mmlu\": float(mmlu[i]), \"helm\": float(helm[i])}\n             for i, (m, t) in enumerate(zip(panel, theta))],\n            key=lambda d: -d[\"theta\"],\n        ),\n        \"success_r_gt_0_85\": bool(r_mmlu > 0.85),\n        \"n_models\": len(panel),\n    }\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 5.5: Consistency baselines (v2 new)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef compute_consistency_baselines(clusters, responses, panel):\n    \"\"\"Per-model paraphrase-agreement, negation-invariance, composite scores.\n\n    For each cluster c, define per-model agreement:\n      paraphrase_ok = (parsed(paraphrase) == parsed(seed))\n      negation_inv  = domain-dependent relational inverse holds (see docstring)\n    Aggregate per-model:\n      paraphrase_agreement_rate = mean over clusters of paraphrase_ok\n      negation_invariance_rate  = mean over clusters of negation_inv\n      composite                = mean of the two\n    \"\"\"\n    per_model = {m: {\"paraphrase_ok\": [], \"negation_inv\": []} for m in panel}\n\n    def _flip(label, domain):\n        if domain == \"logic\":\n            return \"I\" if label == \"V\" else \"V\"\n        if domain == \"fol\":\n            return {\"TRUE\": \"FALSE\", \"FALSE\": \"TRUE\"}.get(label, label)\n        return label\n\n    for mi, model in enumerate(panel):\n        records = responses[model]\n        for ci, cluster in enumerate(clusters):\n            idx = ci * 4\n            variant_layout = _variant_layout_for(cluster)\n            parsed = {}\n            for j, role in enumerate(variant_layout):\n                rec = records[idx + j] if (idx + j) < len(records) else None\n                parsed[role] = (parse_for_domain(rec.parsed if rec else None,\n                                                 cluster[\"domain\"], role)\n                                if rec else None)\n            # Paraphrase agreement\n            if \"paraphrase\" in parsed and \"seed\" in parsed:\n                p_seed = parsed[\"seed\"]\n                p_para = parsed[\"paraphrase\"]\n                if p_seed is not None and p_para is not None:\n                    if cluster[\"domain\"] in {\"logic\", \"fol\"}:\n                        per_model[model][\"paraphrase_ok\"].append(int(p_para == p_seed))\n                    elif cluster[\"domain\"] == \"reading\":\n                        per_model[model][\"paraphrase_ok\"].append(\n                            int(str(p_para).strip().lower() == str(p_seed).strip().lower())\n                        )\n                    else:\n                        try:\n                            per_model[model][\"paraphrase_ok\"].append(\n                                int(int(p_para) == int(p_seed))\n                            )\n                        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n                            per_model[model][\"paraphrase_ok\"].append(0)\n                else:\n                    per_model[model][\"paraphrase_ok\"].append(0)\n            # Negation invariance\n            if \"negation\" in parsed and \"seed\" in parsed:\n                domain = cluster[\"domain\"]\n                if domain == \"logic\":\n                    inv = (parsed[\"negation\"] is not None\n                           and parsed[\"seed\"] is not None\n                           and parsed[\"negation\"] == _flip(parsed[\"seed\"], domain))\n                elif domain == \"fol\":\n                    if parsed[\"seed\"] == \"UNCERTAIN\":\n                        inv = parsed[\"negation\"] == \"UNCERTAIN\"\n                    else:\n                        inv = (parsed[\"negation\"] is not None\n                               and parsed[\"negation\"] == _flip(parsed[\"seed\"], domain))\n                elif domain == \"reading\":\n                    inv = (parsed[\"negation\"] in {\"YES\", \"NO\"}\n                           and parsed[\"seed\"] in {\"YES\", \"NO\"}\n                           and parsed[\"negation\"] != parsed[\"seed\"])\n                else:  # arithmetic\n                    oracle_neg = cluster[\"answers\"].get(\"negation\", \"NO\")\n                    inv = (parsed[\"negation\"] is not None\n                           and parsed[\"negation\"] == oracle_neg)\n                per_model[model][\"negation_inv\"].append(int(inv))\n\n    out = {}\n    for m in panel:\n        p_ok = np.mean(per_model[m][\"paraphrase_ok\"]) if per_model[m][\"paraphrase_ok\"] else float(\"nan\")\n        n_inv = np.mean(per_model[m][\"negation_inv\"]) if per_model[m][\"negation_inv\"] else float(\"nan\")\n        if not math.isnan(p_ok) and not math.isnan(n_inv):\n            composite = float((p_ok + n_inv) / 2.0)\n        else:\n            composite = float(\"nan\")\n        out[m] = {\n            \"paraphrase_agreement_rate\": float(p_ok) if not math.isnan(p_ok) else float(\"nan\"),\n            \"negation_invariance_rate\": float(n_inv) if not math.isnan(n_inv) else float(\"nan\"),\n            \"composite\": composite,\n            \"n_clusters_evaluated\": int(len(per_model[m][\"paraphrase_ok\"])),\n        }\n    return out\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 6: Contamination simulation\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef simulate_contamination(\n    raw_matrix,\n    panel,\n    target_model,\n    *,\n    cluster_ids,\n {0..4} raw count matrix into K ordinal categories.\n\n    K=2: 0 vs >=1 (2PL collapse)\n    K=3: 0-1 vs 2 vs >=3 (iter-1 default)\n    K=4: 0 vs 1 vs 2 vs >=3 (recommended by research_report)\n np.where(raw >= 3, 2, np.where(raw >= 2, 1, 0)).astype(np.int8)\n    elif K == 4:\n        out = np.where(raw >= 3, 3,\n                       np.where(raw == 2, 2,\n                                np.where(raw == 1, 1, 0))).astype(np.int8)\n    elif K == 5:\n        out = np.where(raw >= 4, 4,\n                       np.where(raw == 3, 3,\n                                np.where(raw == 2, 2,\n                                         np.where(raw == 1, 1, 0)))).astype(np.int8)\n    else:\n        raise ValueError(f\"K must be in {{2,3,4,5}}, got {K}\")\n    return out\n\n\ndef fit_grm(score_matrix, *, max_iter: int = 200) -> GRMResult:\n    \"\"\"Fit a Graded Response Model via girth.grm_mml.\n\n    Score matrix is (M, I) with values in {0, 1, ..., K-1}.\n    girth expects (I, M) \u2014 items x persons \u2014 so we transpose.\n    \"\"\"\n    import girth\n\n    M, I = score_matrix.shape\n    K = int(score_matrix.max()) + 1\n    logger.info(f\"Fitting GRM on ({I} items, {M} persons, {K} categories)\")\n\n    X = score_matrix.T.astype(int)\n    X = np.clip(X, 0, K - 1)\n    if X.min() == X.max():\n        logger.warning(\"Score matrix has zero variance; GRM cannot be fit.\")\n        return GRMResult(\n            ability=np.zeros(M),\n            discrimination=np.zeros(I),\n            difficulty=np.zeros((I, max(1, K - 1))),\n            convergence_iters=0,\n            aic=float(\"nan\"),\n            bic=float(\"nan\"),\n            n_categories=K,\n            items_dropped=list(range(I)),\n            fit_success=False,\n        )\n\n    try:\n        res = girth.grm_mml(X)\n        ability = np.asarray(res[\"Ability\"], dtype=float)\n        discrimination = np.asarray(res[\"Discrimination\"], dtype=float)\n        difficulty = np.asarray(res[\"Difficulty\"], dtype=float)\n        fit_success = True\n    except Exception as exc:\n        logger.warning(f\"GRM fit failed: {exc}\")\n        return GRMResult(\n            ability=np.zeros(M),\n            discrimination=np.ones(I),\n            difficulty=np.zeros((I, max(1, K - 1))),\n            convergence_iters=0,\n            aic=float(\"nan\"),\n            bic=float(\"nan\"),\n            n_categories=K,\n            items_dropped=list(range(I)),\n            fit_success=False,\n        )\n\n    items_dropped = [int(i) for i, a in enumerate(discrimination)\n                     if not np.isfinite(a) or a <= 0]\n    discrimination = np.where(np.isfinite(discrimination) & (discrimination > 0),\n                              discrimination, 1e-3)\n\n    aic_raw = res.get(\"AIC\", float(\"nan\"))\n    bic_raw = res.get(\"BIC\", float(\"nan\"))\n    if isinstance(aic_raw, dict):\n        aic_raw = aic_raw.get(\"final\", float(\"nan\"))\n    if isinstance(bic_raw, dict):\n        bic_raw = bic_raw.get(\"final\", float(\"nan\"))\n    aic = float(aic_raw) if aic_raw is not None else float(\"nan\")\n    bic = float(bic_raw) if bic_raw is not None else float(\"nan\")\n    return GRMResult(\n        ability=ability,\n        discrimination=discrimination,\n        difficulty=difficulty,\n        convergence_iters=int(getattr(res, \"iterations\", 0) or 0),\n        aic=aic,\n        bic=bic,\n        n_categories=K,\n        items_dropped=items_dropped,\n        fit_success=fit_success,\n    )\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 4.5: K-ablation and LOO stability (v2 new)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef grm_k_ablation(raw_matrix, panel,\n                   K_list=(2, 3, 4, 5),\n                   published_mmlu=None,\n                   published_helm=None):\n    \"\"\"Fit the GRM with K in {2,3,4,5} on the same (M, I) raw score matrix.\n\n    For each K, record:\n      - n_categories, AIC, BIC\n      - Pearson r against MMLU, Pearson r against HELM, Spearman rho, Kendall tau\n    The 'recommended K' is the one with the lowest BIC; report it explicitly.\n    \"\"\"\n    from scipy.stats import spearmanr, kendalltau\n\n    out = {}\n    for K in K_list:\n        score = _collapse_to_K(raw_matrix, K)\n        grm = fit_grm(score.astype(np.int8))\n        theta = np.asarray(grm.ability, dtype=float)\n        try:\n            if published_mmlu is not None and len(np.unique(theta)) > 1:\n                r_mmlu = float(np.corrcoef(theta, published_mmlu)[0, 1])\n                rho_mmlu = float(spearmanr(theta, published_mmlu).statistic)\n                tau_mmlu = float(kendalltau(theta, published_mmlu).statistic)\n            else:\n                r_mmlu = rho_mmlu = tau_mmlu = float(\"nan\")\n            if published_helm is not None and len(np.unique(theta)) > 1:\n                r_helm = float(np.corrcoef(theta, published_helm)[0, 1])\n                rho_helm = float(spearmanr(theta, published_helm).statistic)\n                tau_helm = float(kendalltau(theta, published_helm).statistic)\n            else:\n                r_helm = rho_helm = tau_helm = float(\"nan\")\n        except Exception as exc:\n            logger.warning(f\"K={K} correlation failed: {exc}\")\n            r_mmlu = r_helm = rho_mmlu = tau_mmlu = rho_helm = tau_helm = float(\"nan\")\n\n        n_items = int(raw_matrix.shape[1])\n        n_persons = int(raw_matrix.shape[0])\n        # Thresholds: (K-1)*n_items; discriminations: n_items; abilities: n_persons\n        n_params = (K - 1) * n_items + n_items + n_persons\n        out[f\"K={K}\"] = {\n            \"n_categories\": int(grm.n_categories),\n            \"n_params\": n_params,\n            \"log_likelihood\": float(\"nan\"),  # girth doesn't expose directly\n            \"aic\": float(grm.aic) if grm.aic is not None and not math.isnan(grm.aic) else float(\"nan\"),\n            \"bic\": float(grm.bic) if grm.bic is not None and not math.isnan(grm.bic) else float(\"nan\"),\n            \"r_mmlu\": r_mmlu,\n            \"r_helm\": r_helm,\n            \"spearman_rho_mmlu\": rho_mmlu,\n            \"kendall_tau_mmlu\": tau_mmlu,\n            \"spearman_rho_helm\": rho_helm,\n            \"kendall_tau_helm\": tau_helm,\n            \"theta\": [float(t) for t in theta],\n            \"fit_success\": bool(grm.fit_success),\n            \"convergence_iters\": int(grm.convergence_iters),\n        }\n    valid = {k: v for k, v in out.items()\n             if v[\"fit_success\"] and not math.isnan(v[\"bic\"])}\n    if valid:\n        recommended_K = min(valid, key=lambda k: valid[k][\"bic\"])\n    else:\n        recommended_K = \"K=3\"\n    out[\"recommended_K\"] = recommended_K\n    out[\"n_models\"] = int(raw_matrix.shape[0])\n    out[\"n_clusters\"] = int(raw_matrix.shape[1])\n    return out\n\n\ndef loo_theta_stability(raw_matrix, panel, K=3):\n    \"\"\"Leave-one-out stability analysis.\n\n    For each of the M models, drop that model's row, refit the GRM with\n    K categories, and record the Pearson r of the remaining (M-1) thetas\n    vs the full-M thetas (excluding the held-out model itself).\n    \"\"\"\n    score_full = _collapse_to_K(raw_matrix, K)\n    grm_full = fit_grm(score_full.astype(np.int8))\n    full_theta = np.asarray(grm_full.ability, dtype=float)\n    M = raw_matrix.shape[0]\n    per_model_delta = []\n    held_in_rs = []\n    for m in range(M):\n        idx = [i for i in range(M) if i != m]\n        sub = raw_matrix[idx, :]\n        sub_score = _collapse_to_K(sub, K)\n        grm_sub = fit_grm(sub_score.astype(np.int8))\n        sub_theta = np.asarray(grm_sub.ability, dtype=float)\n        comp_theta = full_theta[idx]\n        if len(sub_theta) >= 3 and np.std(sub_theta) > 0 and np.std(comp_theta) > 0:\n            r = float(np.corrcoef(sub_theta, comp_theta)[0, 1])\n        else:\n            r = float(\"nan\")\n        held_in_rs.append(r)\n        max_abs_delta = float(np.max(np.abs(sub_theta - comp_theta)))\n        per_model_delta.append({\n            \"model\": panel[m],\n            \"loo_pearson_r_vs_full_minus_self\": r,\n            \"loo_max_abs_delta_theta\": max_abs_delta,\n        })\n    valid_rs = [r for r in held_in_rs if not math.isnan(r)]\n    return {\n        \"K\": int(K),\n        \"per_model\": per_model_delta,\n        \"mean_loo_r\": float(np.mean(valid_rs)) if valid_rs else float(\"nan\"),\n        \"min_loo_r\": float(np.min(valid_rs)) if valid_rs else float(\"nan\"),\n        \"max_abs_loo_delta\": float(max(d[\"loo_max_abs_delta_theta\"] for d in per_model_delta)),\n    }\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 5: Validation A \u2014 correlation with published accuracy\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef validate_a(grm, panel):\n    \"\"\"Compute Pearson r between theta_j and published MMLU accuracy.\"\"\"\n    mmlu = np.array([PUBLISHED_ACCURACY[m][\"mmlu\"] for m in panel], dtype=float)\n    helm = np.array([PUBLISHED_ACCURACY[m][\"helm\"] for m in panel], dtype=float)\n    theta = np.asarray(grm.ability, dtype=float)\n\n    def pearson(x, y):\n        if len(x) < 3 or np.std(x) == 0 or np.std(y) == 0:\n            return float(\"nan\")\n        return float(np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1])\n\n    r_mmlu = pearson(theta, mmlu)\n    r_helm = pearson(theta, helm)\n\n    from scipy.stats import spearmanr, kendalltau\n    try:\n        rho_mmlu = float(spearmanr(theta, mmlu).statistic)\n        tau_mmlu = float(kendalltau(theta, mmlu).statistic)\n        rho_helm = float(spearmanr(theta, helm).statistic)\n        tau_helm = float(kendalltau(theta, helm).statistic)\n    except Exception as exc:\n        logger.warning(f\"Spearman/Kendall failed: {exc}\")\n        rho_mmlu = tau_mmlu = rho_helm = tau_helm = float(\"nan\")\n\n    def ci(x, y, n_boot=10000, seed=0):\n        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        rs = []\n        n = len(x)\n        for _ in range(n_boot):\n            ix = rng.integers(0, n, size=n)\n            xx, yy = x[ix], y[ix]\n            if np.std(xx) == 0 or np.std(yy) == 0:\n                continue\n            rs.append(pearson(xx, yy))\n        if not rs:\n            return (float(\"nan\"), float(\"nan\"))\n        lo, hi = np.percentile(rs, [2.5, 97.5])\n        return (float(lo), float(hi))\n\n    ci_mmlu = ci(theta, mmlu)\n    ci_helm = ci(theta, helm)\n\n    return {\n        \"r_mmlu\": r_mmlu,\n        \"r_helm\": r_helm,\n        \"spearman_rho_mmlu\": rho_mmlu,\n        \"kendall_tau_mmlu\": tau_mmlu,\n        \"spearman_rho_helm\": rho_helm,\n        \"kendall_tau_helm\": tau_helm,\n        \"ci_mmlu\": ci_mmlu,\n        \"ci_helm\": ci_helm,\n        \"theta_ranking\": sorted(\n            [{\"model\": m, \"theta\": float(t), \"mmlu\": float(mmlu[i]), \"helm\": float(helm[i])}\n             for i, (m, t) in enumerate(zip(panel, theta))],\n            key=lambda d: -d[\"theta\"],\n        ),\n        \"success_r_gt_0_85\": bool(r_mmlu > 0.85),\n        \"n_models\": len(panel),\n    }\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 5.5: Consistency baselines (v2 new)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef compute_consistency_baselines(clusters, responses, panel):\n    \"\"\"Per-model paraphrase-agreement, negation-invariance, composite scores.\n\n    For each cluster c, define per-model agreement:\n      paraphrase_ok = (parsed(paraphrase) == parsed(seed))\n      negation_inv  = domain-dependent relational inverse holds (see docstring)\n    Aggregate per-model:\n      paraphrase_agreement_rate = mean over clusters of paraphrase_ok\n      negation_invariance_rate  = mean over clusters of negation_inv\n      composite                = mean of the two\n    \"\"\"\n    per_model = {m: {\"paraphrase_ok\": [], \"negation_inv\": []} for m in panel}\n\n    def _flip(label, domain):\n        if domain == \"logic\":\n            return \"I\" if label == \"V\" else \"V\"\n        if domain == \"fol\":\n            return {\"TRUE\": \"FALSE\", \"FALSE\": \"TRUE\"}.get(label, label)\n        return label\n\n    for mi, model in enumerate(panel):\n        records = responses[model]\n        for ci, cluster in enumerate(clusters):\n            idx = ci * 4\n            variant_layout = _variant_layout_for(cluster)\n            parsed = {}\n            for j, role in enumerate(variant_layout):\n                rec = records[idx + j] if (idx + j) < len(records) else None\n                parsed[role] = (parse_for_domain(rec.parsed if rec else None,\n                                                 cluster[\"domain\"], role)\n                                if rec else None)\n            # Paraphrase agreement\n            if \"paraphrase\" in parsed and \"seed\" in parsed:\n                p_seed = parsed[\"seed\"]\n                p_para = parsed[\"paraphrase\"]\n                if p_seed is not None and p_para is not None:\n                    if cluster[\"domain\"] in {\"logic\", \"fol\"}:\n                        per_model[model][\"paraphrase_ok\"].append(int(p_para == p_seed))\n                    elif cluster[\"domain\"] == \"reading\":\n                        per_model[model][\"paraphrase_ok\"].append(\n                            int(str(p_para).strip().lower() == str(p_seed).strip().lower())\n                        )\n                    else:\n                        try:\n                            per_model[model][\"paraphrase_ok\"].append(\n                                int(int(p_para) == int(p_seed))\n                            )\n                        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n                            per_model[model][\"paraphrase_ok\"].append(0)\n                else:\n                    per_model[model][\"paraphrase_ok\"].append(0)\n            # Negation invariance\n            if \"negation\" in parsed and \"seed\" in parsed:\n                domain = cluster[\"domain\"]\n                if domain == \"logic\":\n                    inv = (parsed[\"negation\"] is not None\n                           and parsed[\"seed\"] is not None\n                           and parsed[\"negation\"] == _flip(parsed[\"seed\"], domain))\n                elif domain == \"fol\":\n                    if parsed[\"seed\"] == \"UNCERTAIN\":\n                        inv = parsed[\"negation\"] == \"UNCERTAIN\"\n                    else:\n                        inv = (parsed[\"negation\"] is not None\n                               and parsed[\"negation\"] == _flip(parsed[\"seed\"], domain))\n                elif domain == \"reading\":\n                    inv = (parsed[\"negation\"] in {\"YES\", \"NO\"}\n                           and parsed[\"seed\"] in {\"YES\", \"NO\"}\n                           and parsed[\"negation\"] != parsed[\"seed\"])\n                else:  # arithmetic\n                    oracle_neg = cluster[\"answers\"].get(\"negation\", \"NO\")\n                    inv = (parsed[\"negation\"] is not None\n                           and parsed[\"negation\"] == oracle_neg)\n                per_model[model][\"negation_inv\"].append(int(inv))\n\n    out = {}\n    for m in panel:\n        p_ok = np.mean(per_model[m][\"paraphrase_ok\"]) if per_model[m][\"paraphrase_ok\"] else float(\"nan\")\n        n_inv = np.mean(per_model[m][\"negation_inv\"]) if per_model[m][\"negation_inv\"] else float(\"nan\")\n        if not math.isnan(p_ok) and not math.isnan(n_inv):\n            composite = float((p_ok + n_inv) / 2.0)\n        else:\n            composite = float(\"nan\")\n        out[m] = {\n            \"paraphrase_agreement_rate\": float(p_ok) if not math.isnan(p_ok) else float(\"nan\"),\n            \"negation_invariance_rate\": float(n_inv) if not math.isnan(n_inv) else float(\"nan\"),\n            \"composite\": composite,\n            \"n_clusters_evaluated\": int(len(per_model[m][\"paraphrase_ok\"])),\n        }\n    return out\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 6: Contamination simulation\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef simulate_contamination(\n    raw_matrix,\n    panel,\n    target_model,\n    *,\n    cluster_ids,\n    per_example=None,\n    seeds=(0, 1, 42),\n    contamination_fraction=0.30,\n    K=3,\n):\n    \"\"\"Legacy iter-1 contamination: force seed slot correct on 30% of clusters.\"\"\"\n    if per_example is None:\n        raise ValueError(\"simulate_contamination requires per_example records (Stage 3 output)\")\n\n    I = raw_matrix.shape[1]\n    target_idx = panel.index(target_model)\n    n_contam = int(round(contamination_fraction * I))\n\n    seed_ok = {}\n    for ex in per_example:\n        model = ex.get(\"metadata_model\", ex.get(\"model\"))\n        cid = ex.get(\"input\", ex.get(\"cluster_id\"))\n        ok = ex.get(\"metadata_seed_ok\", ex.get(\"seed_ok\"))\n        seed_ok[(model, cid)] = int(ok)\n\n    results = []\n    for seed in seeds:\n        rng_local = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        contam_cluster_ids = set(rng_local.choice(cluster_ids, size=n_contam,\n                                                   replace=False).tolist())\n\n        contam_raw = raw_matrix.copy()\n        for ci, cid in enumerate(cluster_ids):\n            recs = [\n                e for e in per_example\n                if e.get(\"metadata_model\", e.get(\"model\")) == target_model\n                and e.get(\"input\", e.get(\"cluster_id\")) == cid\n            ]\n            if not recs:\n                continue\n            ex = recs[0]\n            details = ex.get(\"metadata_details\", ex.get(\"details\", \"{}\"))\n            details_dict = json.loads(details) if isinstance(details, str) else details\n            role_order_keys = [r for r in [\"seed\", \"paraphrase\", \"negation\",\n                                            \"contrapositive\", \"inverse\",\n                                            \"distractor\", \"quantifier_shift\"]\n                                if r in details_dict]\n            if not role_order_keys:\n                role_order_keys = list(details_dict.keys())[:4]\n            old_flags = [int(details_dict.get(r, {\"ok\": 0})[\"ok\"])\n                         for r in role_order_keys[:4]]\n            new_flags = list(old_flags)\n            if cid in contam_cluster_ids and new_flags:\n                new_flags[0] = 1\n            contam_raw[target_idx, ci] = sum(new_flags)\n\n        contam_score = _collapse_to_K(contam_raw, K)\n\n        clean_static = float(np.mean([seed_ok[(target_model, cid)]\n                                       for cid in cluster_ids]))\n        contam_static = float(np.mean([\n            1 if cid in contam_cluster_ids else seed_ok[(target_model, cid)]\n            for cid in cluster_ids\n        ]))\n\n        clean_grm = fit_grm(_collapse_to_K(raw_matrix.astype(np.int8), K))\n        contam_grm = fit_grm(contam_score)\n\n        results.append({\n            \"seed\": int(seed),\n            \"n_contaminated_clusters\": int(n_contam),\n            \"static_acc_clean\": clean_static,\n            \"static_acc_contam\": contam_static,\n            \"static_acc_delta\": contam_static - clean_static,\n            \"theta_clean\": float(clean_grm.ability[target_idx]),\n            \"theta_contam\": float(contam_grm.ability[target_idx]),\n            \"theta_delta\": float(contam_grm.ability[target_idx]\n                                 - clean_grm.ability[target_idx]),\n        })\n\n    deltas_static = [r[\"static_acc_delta\"] for r in results]\n    deltas_theta = [r[\"theta_delta\"] for r in results]\n    summary = {\n        \"target_model\": target_model,\n        \"contamination_fraction\": contamination_fraction,\n        \"K\": int(K),\n        \"per_seed\": results,\n        \"mean_static_acc_delta\": float(np.mean(deltas_static)),\n        \"mean_theta_delta\": float(np.mean(deltas_theta)),\n        \"std_theta_delta\": float(np.std(deltas_theta)),\n        \"contamination_resistance_holds\": bool(\n            np.mean(deltas_static) > 0.05\n            and np.mean(deltas_theta) <= 0.10\n        ),\n        \"protocol\": \"iter-1 response-overwrite (legacy, artificial)\",\n    }\n    return summary\n\n\ndef natural_contamination_simulation(\n    raw_matrix,\n    panel,\n    *,\n    target_model,\n    cluster_ids,\n    per_example,\n    clusters,\n    contaminated_calls_by_target=None,\n    seeds=(0, 1, 42, 7, 99),\n    contamination_fraction=0.30,\n    K=3,\n):\n    \"\"\"Natural contamination simulation via system-prompt oracle injection.\n\n    For each seed:\n      - Pick contamination_fraction of clusters.\n      - For each contaminated cluster, the contaminated_calls_by_target dict\n        contains the re-queried responses (with role='contam_<variant>') from\n        the query_contaminated() pass. We rebuild the contaminated raw_matrix\n        for the target model by:\n          * For contaminated clusters: compute the new raw count using the\n            CONTAMINATED responses for ALL four variants (the natural scenario\n            where the model has memorized the cluster globally \u2014 every variant\n            is consistent with the seed oracle after injection).\n          * For non-contaminated clusters: keep the clean raw count.\n        Then refit the GRM on the full (M, I) matrix.\n\n    Returns per-seed static_acc_clean/contam/delta + theta_clean/contam/delta.\n    \"\"\"\n    I = raw_matrix.shape[1]\n    target_idx = panel.index(target_model)\n    n_contam = int(round(contamination_fraction * I))\n\n    # Index contaminated calls by (cluster_id, role) for fast retrieval\n    if contaminated_calls_by_target is None:\n        contaminated_calls_by_target = {}\n    contam_index = {}\n    for rec in contaminated_calls_by_target.get(target_model, []):\n        ci = rec.get(\"ci\")\n        cid = cluster_ids[ci] if 0 <= ci < len(cluster_ids) else None\n        role = rec.get(\"role\", \"\").replace(\"contam_\", \"\")\n        if cid and role:\n            contam_index[(cid, role)] = rec\n\n    # Build per-cluster domain/answer lookup from clusters\n    cluster_by_id = {c[\"cluster_id\"]: c for c in clusters}\n\n    seed_ok = {}\n    for ex in per_example:\n        model = ex.get(\"metadata_model\", ex.get(\"model\"))\n        cid = ex.get(\"input\", ex.get(\"cluster_id\"))\n        ok = ex.get(\"metadata_seed_ok\", ex.get(\"seed_ok\"))\n        seed_ok[(model, cid)] = int(ok)\n\n    results = []\n    for seed in seeds:\n        rng_local = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        contam_cluster_ids = set(\n            rng_local.choice(cluster_ids, size=n_contam, replace=False).tolist()\n        )\n\n        contam_raw = raw_matrix.copy()\n        # Track which clusters had any contam data available\n        contam_available_for_static = []\n        for ci, cid in enumerate(cluster_ids):\n            cluster = cluster_by_id.get(cid)\n            if cluster is None:\n                continue\n            domain = cluster[\"domain\"]\n            roles_in_order = _variant_layout_for(cluster)\n            if cid in contam_cluster_ids:\n                new_raw = 0\n                seed_correct_contam = None\n                for role in roles_in_order:\n                    oracle_value = cluster[\"answers\"][role]\n                    if (cid, role) in contam_index:\n                        # Use the contaminated response to score this cell\n                        rec = contam_index[(cid, role)]\n                        parsed = rec.get(\"parsed\")\n                        ok = _score_cell_with_oracle(parsed, oracle_value, domain, role)\n                        new_raw += int(ok)\n                        if role == \"seed\":\n                            seed_correct_contam = int(ok)\n                    else:\n                        # No contaminated response available: fall back to clean\n                        recs = [\n                            e for e in per_example\n                            if e.get(\"metadata_model\", e.get(\"model\")) == target_model\n                            and e.get(\"input\", e.get(\"cluster_id\")) == cid\n                        ]\n                        if recs:\n                            details = recs[0].get(\"metadata_details\",\n                                                  recs[0].get(\"details\", \"{}\"))\n                            details_dict = json.loads(details) if isinstance(details, str) else details\n                            ok_clean = int(details_dict.get(role, {\"ok\": requests_per_minute=requests_per_minute, panel=panel,\n    ))\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 2.5: natural contamination query (separate ledger with $1 sub-cap)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nasync def _stage_natural_contam_query_async(\n    clusters: list[dict],\n    target_models: list[str],\n    panel: list[str],\n    seeds: list[int],\n    contamination_fraction: float = 0.30,\n    contamination_budget_usd: float = 1.0,\n    concurrency: int = 10,\n    requests_per_minute: float = 12.0,\n) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:\n    \"\"\"For each (target_model, seed), re-query the contaminated clusters with a\n    system-prompt oracle injection. Returns per-model list of CallResult-like\n    dicts (with role='contam_<variant>').\n    \"\"\"\n    contam_ledger = CostLedger(budget_usd=contamination_budget_usd, warn_usd=0.5,\n                                critical_usd=0.8)\n    all_results: dict[str, list[dict]] = {m: [] for m in target_models}\n    cluster_ids = [c[\"cluster_id\"] for c in clusters]\n    panel_dict = {m: DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL[m] for m in target_models if m in DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL}\n\n    for target_model in target_models:\n        logger.info(f\"Stage 2.5: natural contamination re-query on {target_model}\")\n        for s_idx, seed in enumerate(seeds):\n            rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n            n_contam = int(round(contamination_fraction * len(cluster_ids)))\n            contam_ids = set(rng.choice(cluster_ids, size=n_contam, replace=False).tolist())\n            oracle_by_idx = {ci: str(c[\"oracle_correct\"]) for ci, c in enumerate(clusters)\n                             if c[\"cluster_id\"] in contam_ids}\n            try:\n                recs = await query_contaminated(\n                    panel_dict,\n                    clusters,\n                    target_model=target_model,\n                    contaminated_ids=contam_ids,\n                    oracle_by_id=oracle_by_idx,\n                    ledger=contam_ledger,\n                    concurrency=concurrency,\n                    requests_per_minute=requests_per_minute,\n                )\n            except SpendExceeded as exc:\n                logger.warning(f\"Contam spend exceeded on {target_model} seed={seed}: {exc}\")\n                break\n            # Index by cluster_id+role\n            for ci, c in enumerate(clusters):\n                if c[\"cluster_id\"] not in contam_ids:\n                    continue\n                for j, role in enumerate(c[\"variants\"].keys()):\n                    idx = j\n                    if idx >= len(recs):\n                        continue\n                    r = recs[idx]\n                    all_results[target_model].append({\n                        \"ci\": ci,\n                        \"cluster_id\": c[\"cluster_id\"],\n                        \"role\": f\"contam_{role}\",\n                        \"success\": r.success,\n                        \"parsed\": r.parsed if r.parsed is not None else None,\n                        \"input_tokens\": r.input_tokens,\n                        \"output_tokens\": r.output_tokens,\n                        \"cost_usd\": r.cost_usd,\n                    })\n            logger.info(f\"  Seed {seed}: {len(contam_ids)} contaminated clusters, \"\n                        f\"spend ${contam_ledger.total_spent:.4f}\")\n\n    logger.info(f\"Contam query done; total spend ${contam_ledger.total_spent:.4f}\")\n    return all_results\n\n\ndef stage_natural_contam_query(\n    clusters: list[dict],\n    *,\n    target_models: list[str],\n    panel: list[str],\n    seeds: list[int],\n    contamination_fraction: float = 0.30,\n    contamination_budget_usd: float = 1.0,\n    concurrency: int = 10,\n    requests_per_minute: float = 12.0,\n) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:\n    return asyncio.run(_stage_natural_contam_query_async(\n        clusters, target_models, panel, seeds,\n        contamination_fraction=contamination_fraction,\n        contamination_budget_usd=contamination_budget_usd,\n        concurrency=concurrency,\n        requests_per_minute=requests_per_minute,\n    ))\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 3: coherence scoring + serialise evaluation\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef stage_score(\n    clusters: list[dict],\n    responses: dict[str, list],\n    panel: list[str],\n) -> dict:\n    logger.info(f\"Stage 3: scoring coherence ({len(panel)} models x {len(clusters)} clusters)\")\n    t0 = time.monotonic()\n    out = score_all(clusters, responses, panel)\n    dt = time.monotonic() - t0\n    logger.info(f\"Stage 3 done in {dt:.2f}s\")\n    matrix = out[\"matrix\"]\n    raw_matrix = out[\"raw_matrix\"]\n\n    metrics_agg = {\n        \"n_models\": len(panel),\n \"frac_score_0\": float(np.mean(matrix == 0)),\n        \"mean_ordinal_score\": float(matrix.mean()),\n        \"mean_raw_correct\": float(raw_matrix.mean()),\n        \"static_acc_mean\": float(np.mean([v[\"static_acc_on_seeds\"] for v in out[\"per_model\"].values()])),\n        \"static_acc_max\": float(np.max([v[\"static_acc_on_seeds\"] for v in out[\"per_model\"].values()])),\n        \"static_acc_min\": float(np.min([v[\"static_acc_on_seeds\"] for v in out[\"per_model\"].values()])),\n        \"static_acc_std\": float(np.std([v[\"static_acc_on_seeds\"] for v in out[\"per_model\"].values()])),\n        \"n_clusters_per_domain\": {\n            d: int(sum(1 for c in clusters if c[\"domain\"] == d))\n            for d in [\"logic\", \"arithmetic\", \"reading\", \"fol\"]\n        },\n    }\n\n    eval_out = {\n        \"metadata\": {\n            \"evaluation_name\": \"M-IRT v2 coherence scoring\",\n            \"description\": (\n                \"Ordinal coherence score (0/1/2) per (model, cluster) cell based on how many of \"\n                \"the 4 metamorphic variants the model answered correctly. v2 supports four \"\n                \"domains (logic, arithmetic, reading, fol) and uses a reference-free \"\n                \"arithmetic negation template.\"\n            ),\n            \"panel\": panel,\n            \"scoring_scheme\": (\n str(ex[\"score\"]),\n                        \"metadata_model\": ex[\"model\"],\n                        \"metadata_domain\": ex[\"domain\"],\n                        \"metadata_seed_ok\": ex[\"seed_ok\"],\n                        \"metadata_raw_correct\": ex[\"raw\"],\n                        \"metadata_details\": json.dumps(ex[\"details\"]),\n                    }\n                    for ex in out[\"per_example\"]\n                ],\n            }\n        ],\n    }\n\n    EXP_EVAL_OUT = _exp_eval_path()\n    EXP_EVAL_OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    EXP_EVAL_OUT.write_text(json.dumps(eval_out, indent=2))\n    logger.info(f\"Saved {EXP_EVAL_OUT}\")\n\n    mpath = _matrices_path()\n    mpath.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    np.savez_compressed(\n        mpath,\n        score_matrix=matrix,\n        raw_matrix=raw_matrix,\n        panel=np.array(panel, dtype=object),\n        cluster_ids=np.array([c[\"cluster_id\"] for c []\n    # Prefer qwen-2.5-7b if present (matches iter-1); else fallback to a mid-tier\n    if \"qwen/qwen-2.5-7b-instruct\" in panel:\n        contam_targets.append(\"qwen/qwen-2.5-7b-instruct\")\n  \"panel\": panel,\n            \"n_clusters\": len(clusters),\n            \"n_logic\": sum(1 for c in clusters if c[\"domain\"] == \"logic\"),\n            \"n_arithmetic\": sum(1 for c in clusters lines = [\"# M-IRT v2 contamination comparison report\\n\",\n             \"Comparison of two contamination protocols applied to the same MIC \"\n             \"panel:\\n\",\n             \"1. {nat['mean_static_acc_delta']:+.3f}, \"\n                         f\"resistance_holds = {nat['contamination_resistance_holds']}, \"\n                         f\"n_calls = {nat.get('n_contamination_calls', '?')}\")\n        lines.append(\"\")\n    lines.append(\"## Figure 4\\n\")\n    lines.append(\"![Contamination delta-theta bar  )(**{k: rec.get(k) for k in\n                     (\"success\", \"response_text\", \"parsed\",\n                      \"input_tokens\", \"output_tokens\", \"cost_usd\",\n in contam_ids:\n                    continue\n                for j, role in enumerate(c[\"variants\"].keys()):\n                    idx = j\n                    if idx >= len(recs):\n c[\"cluster_id\"],\n                        \"role\": f\"contam_{role}\",\n                        \"success\": r.success,\n                        \"parsed\": r.parsed if r.parsed is not None else })\n            logger.info(f\"  Seed {seed}: {len(contam_ids)} contaminated clusters, \"\n                        f\"spend ${contam_ledger.total_spent:.4f}\")\n\n    logger.info(f\"Contam query done; total spend ${contam_ledger.total_spent:.4f}\")\n    return all_results\n\n\ndef stage_natural_contam_query(\n    clusters: list[dict],\n    *,\n    target_models: list[str],\n    panel: list[str],\n contamination_budget_usd=contamination_budget_usd,\n        concurrency=concurrency,\n        requests_per_minute=requests_per_minute,\n    ))\n\n\n#   \"static_acc_min\": float(np.min([v[\"static_acc_on_seeds\"] for v in out[\"per_model\"].values()])),\n        \"static_acc_std\": float(np.std([v[\"static_acc_on_seeds\"] for v in for ex in out[\"per_example\"]\n                ],\n            }\n        ],\n    }\n\n    EXP_EVAL_OUT = _exp_eval_path()\n    EXP_EVAL_OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n []\n    # Prefer qwen-2.5-7b if present (matches iter-1); else fallback to a mid-tier\n    if \"qwen/qwen-2.5-7b-instruct\" in panel:\n        contam_targets.append(\"qwen/qwen-2.5-7b-instruct\")\n lines = [\"# M-IRT v2 contamination comparison report\\n\",\n             \"Comparison of two contamination protocols applied to the same MIC \"\n             \"panel:\\n\",\n             \"1. lines.append(f\"- **Natural** (v2):    mean \u0394\u03b8 = \"\n                         f\"{nat['mean_theta_delta']:+.3f}, \"\n                         f\"mean \u0394static_acc = {nat['mean_static_acc_delta']:+.3f}, \"\n                         f\"resistance_holds = {nat['contamination_resistance_holds']}, \"\n                         f\"n_calls = {nat.get('n_contamination_calls', '?')}\")\n        lines.append(\"\")\n    lines.append(\"## Figure 4\\n\")\n    lines.append(\"![Contamination delta-theta bar (\"parsed\", object),\n                     (\"input_tokens\", int), (\"output_tokens\", int),\n                     (\"cost_usd\", float), (\"latency_s\", float), (\"error\", object)]\n                )(**{k: rec.get(k) for k in\n                     (\"success\", \"response_text\", \"parsed\",\n                      \"input_tokens\", \"output_tokens\", \"cost_usd\",\n                      \"latency_s\", \"error\")}))\n        out[m] = recs\n    return out\n\n\ndef _to_schema_format(method_out: dict, clusters: list[dict]) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Reshape method_out into the exp_gen_sol_out \"metadata_natural_contamination\": json.dumps(\n                method_out.get(\"validation_b_natural_contamination\", {})\n            ),\n        }\n        examples.append(example)\n    return {\n        \"metadata\": method_out.get(\"metadata\", {}),\n        \"datasets\": [\n            {\"dataset\": \"m_irt_v2_metamorphic_clusters\", \"examples\": examples}\n        ],\n    }\n\n\ndef _build_formatted_variants():\n    \"\"\"Generate full/mini/preview variants at workspace root in schema format.\"\"\"\n    src = json.loads(_method_out_path().read_text())\n    clusters = _load_clusters_from_artifacts()\n    schema_full = _to_schema_format(src, clusters)\n    FULL_METHOD_OUT.write_text(json.dumps(schema_full, indent=2, default=float))\n    MINI_METHOD_OUT.write_text(json.dumps(\n        _trim_for_mini(schema_full, max_items=10, str_max=200),\n        indent=2, default=float,\n    ))\n    PREVIEW_METHOD_OUT.write_text(json.dumps(\n concurrency: int,\n    dry_run: bool,\n    requests_per_minute: float,\n    panel: list[str] | None = None,\n) -> dict[str, list]:\n    panel = panel or list(DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL.keys())\n    # Filter DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL to the panel list\n    panel_dict = {m: DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL[m] for m in panel if m in DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL}\n    if not panel_dict:\n        raise ValueError(\"panel is empty\")\n\n    ledger = CostLedger(budget_usd=budget_usd)\n    log_path = _calls_log_path()\n    logger.info(f\"Stage 2: querying {len(panel_dict)} models x {len(clusters)} clusters x 4 variants\")\n    t0 = time.monotonic()\n    try:\n        responses = await query_panel(\n            panel_dict,\n            clusters,\n            ledger=ledger,\n            concurrency=concurrency,\n            log_path=log_path,\n            dry_run=dry_run,\n            requests_per_minute=requests_per_minute,\n        )\n    except SpendExceeded as exc:\n        logger.error(f\"Spend exceeded mid-sweep: {exc}\")\n        raise\n    dt = time.monotonic() - t0\n    logger.info(f\"Stage 2 done in {dt:.2f}s; cumulative spend ${ledger.total_spent:.4f}\")\n\n    # Persist per-model jsonl snapshots to the active responses dir\n    rdir = _responses_dir()\n    for model, recs in responses.items():\n        out_path = rdir / f\"{_safe_filename(model)}.jsonl\"\n        with out_path.open(\"w\") as f:\n            for r in recs:\n                f.write(json.dumps({\n                    \"success\": r.success,\n                    \"parsed\": r.parsed if r.parsed is not None else None,\n                    \"raw_response\": r.response_text[:300] if r.response_text else \"\",\n                    \"input_tokens\": r.input_tokens,\n                    \"output_tokens\": r.output_tokens,\n                    \"cost_usd\": r.cost_usd,\n                    \"latency_s\": r.latency_s,\n                    \"error\": r.error,\n                }) + \"\\n\")\n    spend_log_path = _spend_log_path()\n    spend_log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    with spend_log_path.open(\"w\") as f:\n        for entry in ledger.spend_log:\n            f.write(json.dumps(entry) + \"\\n\")\n    return responses\n\n\ndef stage_query(\n    clusters: list[dict],\n    *,\n    budget_usd: float,\n    concurrency: int,\n    dry_run: bool,\n    requests_per_minute: float = 12.0,\n    panel: list[str] | None = None,\n) -> dict[str, list]:\n    return asyncio.run(_stage_query_async(\n        clusters, budget_usd=budget_usd,\n        concurrency=concurrency, dry_run=dry_run,\n        requests_per_minute=requests_per_minute, panel=panel,\n    ))\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 2.5: natural contamination query (separate ledger with $1 sub-cap)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nasync def _stage_natural_contam_query_async(\n    clusters: list[dict],\n    target_models: list[str],\n    panel: list[str],\n    seeds: list[int],\n    contamination_fraction: float = 0.30,\n    contamination_budget_usd: float = 1.0,\n    concurrency: int = 10,\n    requests_per_minute: float = 12.0,\n) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:\n    \"\"\"For each (target_model, seed), re-query the contaminated clusters with a\n    system-prompt oracle injection. Returns per-model list of CallResult-like\n    dicts (with role='contam_<variant>').\n    \"\"\"\n    contam_ledger = CostLedger(budget_usd=contamination_budget_usd, warn_usd=0.5,\n                                critical_usd=0.8)\n    all_results: dict[str, list[dict]] = {m: [] for m in target_models}\n    cluster_ids = [c[\"cluster_id\"] for c in clusters]\n    panel_dict = {m: DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL[m] for m in target_models if m in DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL}\n\n    for target_model in target_models:\n        logger.info(f\"Stage 2.5: natural contamination re-query on {target_model}\")\n        for s_idx, seed in enumerate(seeds):\n            rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n            n_contam = int(round(contamination_fraction * len(cluster_ids)))\n            contam_ids = set(rng.choice(cluster_ids, size=n_contam, replace=False).tolist())\n            oracle_by_idx = {ci: str(c[\"oracle_correct\"]) for ci, c in enumerate(clusters)\n                             if c[\"cluster_id\"] in contam_ids}\n            try:\n                recs = await query_contaminated(\n                    panel_dict,\n                    clusters,\n                    target_model=target_model,\n                    contaminated_ids=contam_ids,\n                    oracle_by_id=oracle_by_idx,\n                    ledger=contam_ledger,\n                    concurrency=concurrency,\n                    requests_per_minute=requests_per_minute,\n                )\n            except SpendExceeded as exc:\n                logger.warning(f\"Contam spend exceeded on {target_model} seed={seed}: {exc}\")\n                break\n            # Index by cluster_id+role\n            for ci, c in enumerate(clusters):\n                if c[\"cluster_id\"] not in contam_ids:\n                    continue\n                for j, role in enumerate(c[\"variants\"].keys()):\n                    idx = j\n                    if idx >= len(recs):\n                        continue\n                    r = recs[idx]\n                    all_results[target_model].append({\n                        \"ci\": ci,\n                        \"cluster_id\": c[\"cluster_id\"],\n                        \"role\": f\"contam_{role}\",\n                        \"success\": r.success,\n                        \"parsed\": r.parsed if r.parsed is not None else None,\n                        \"input_tokens\": r.input_tokens,\n                        \"output_tokens\": r.output_tokens,\n                        \"cost_usd\": r.cost_usd,\n                    })\n            logger.info(f\"  Seed {seed}: {len(contam_ids)} contaminated clusters, \"\n                        f\"spend ${contam_ledger.total_spent:.4f}\")\n\n    logger.info(f\"Contam query done; total spend ${contam_ledger.total_spent:.4f}\")\n    return all_results\n\n\ndef stage_natural_contam_query(\n    clusters: list[dict],\n    *,\n    target_models: list[str],\n    panel: list[str],\n    seeds: list[int],\n    contamination_fraction: float = 0.30,\n    contamination_budget_usd: float = 1.0,\n    concurrency: int = 10,\n    requests_per_minute: float = 12.0,\n) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:\n    return asyncio.run(_stage_natural_contam_query_async(\n        clusters, target_models, panel, seeds,\n        contamination_fraction=contamination_fraction,\n        contamination_budget_usd=contamination_budget_usd,\n        concurrency=concurrency,\n        requests_per_minute=requests_per_minute,\n    ))\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 3: coherence scoring + serialise evaluation\n# logger.info(f\"Stage 3: scoring coherence ({len(panel)} models x {len(clusters)} clusters)\")\n    t0 = time.monotonic()\n    out = score_all(clusters, responses, panel)\n    dt = time.monotonic() - t0\n    logger.info(f\"Stage 3 done in {dt:.2f}s\")\n    matrix = out[\"matrix\"]\n    raw_matrix = out[\"raw_matrix\"]\n\n    metrics_agg = {\n        \"n_models\": len(panel),\n \"frac_score_0\": float(np.mean(matrix == 0)),\n        \"mean_ordinal_score\": float(matrix.mean()),\n        \"mean_raw_correct\": float(raw_matrix.mean()),\n        \"static_acc_mean\":   \"static_acc_min\": float(np.min([v[\"static_acc_on_seeds\"] for v in out[\"per_model\"].values()])),\n        \"static_acc_std\": float(np.std([v[\"static_acc_on_seeds\"] for v in (logic, arithmetic, reading, fol) and uses a reference-free \"\n                \"arithmetic negation template.\"\n            ),\n            \"panel\": panel,\n            \"scoring_scheme\": (\n ex[\"seed_ok\"],\n                        \"metadata_raw_correct\": ex[\"raw\"],\n                        \"metadata_details\": json.dumps(ex[\"details\"]),\n                    }\n                    for ex in out[\"per_example\"]\n                ],\n            }\n        ],\n    }\n\n    EXP_EVAL_OUT = _exp_eval_path()\n    EXP_EVAL_OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    EXP_EVAL_OUT.write_text(json.dumps(eval_out, indent=2))\n    logger.info(f\"Saved {EXP_EVAL_OUT}\")\n\n    mpath = _matrices_path()\n    mpath.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    np.savez_compressed(\n        mpath,\n        score_matrix=matrix,\n        raw_matrix=raw_matrix,\n        panel=np.array(panel, dtype=object),\n        cluster_ids=np.array([c[\"cluster_id\"] for c {nat['mean_static_acc_delta']:+.3f}, \"\n                         f\"resistance_holds = {nat['contamination_resistance_holds']}, \"\n                         f\"n_calls = {nat.get('n_contamination_calls', '?')}\")\n        lines.append(\"\")\n    lines.append(\"## Figure 4\\n\")\n    lines.append(\"![Contamination delta-theta bar try:\n        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (4 * 3600, 4 * 3600))\n    except (ValueError, OSError) as exc:\n        logger.warning(f\"Could not set RLIMIT_CPU: {exc}\")\n\n\n# \"artifacts_mini\"\nARTIFACTS_MINI.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\nFULL_METHOD_OUT = WORKSPACE / \"full_method_out.json\"\nMINI_METHOD_OUT = WORKSPACE /     for c in clusters\n                ],\n            }\n        ],\n    }\n\n    EXP_GEN_OUT = _exp_gen_path()\n    EXP_GEN_OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    EXP_GEN_OUT.write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=2))\n    logger.info(f\"Saved {EXP_GEN_OUT}\")\n    return clusters\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n#    ledger = CostLedger(budget_usd=budget_usd)\n    log_path = _calls_log_path()\n    logger.info(f\"Stage 2: querying {len(panel_dict)} models x {len(clusters)} clusters x 4 variants\")\n    t0 = spend_log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    with spend_log_path.open(\"w\") as f:\n        for entry in ledger.spend_log:\n            f.write(json.dumps(entry) + \"\\n\")\n list[str] | None = None,\n) -> dict[str, list]:\n    return asyncio.run(_stage_query_async(\n        clusters, budget_usd=budget_usd,\n        concurrency=concurrency, dry_run=dry_run,\n        requests_per_minute=requests_per_minute, panel=panel,\n    ))\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 2.5: natural contamination query (separate ledger with $1 sub-cap)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nasync def _stage_natural_contam_query_async(\n    clusters: list[dict],\n    target_models: list[str],\n    panel: list[str],\n    seeds: list[int],\n    contamination_fraction: float = 0.30,\n    contamination_budget_usd: float = 1.0,\n    concurrency: int = 10,\n    requests_per_minute: float = 12.0,\n) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:\n    \"\"\"For each (target_model, seed), re-query the contaminated clusters with a\n    system-prompt oracle injection. Returns per-model list of CallResult-like\n    dicts (with role='contam_<variant>').\n    \"\"\"\n    contam_ledger = CostLedger(budget_usd=contamination_budget_usd, warn_usd=0.5,\n                                critical_usd=0.8)\n    all_results: dict[str, list[dict]] = {m: [] for m in target_models}\n    cluster_ids = [c[\"cluster_id\"] for c in clusters]\n    panel_dict = {m: DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL[m] for m in target_models if m in DEFAULT_MODEL_PANEL}\n\n    for target_model in target_models:\n        logger.info(f\"Stage 2.5: natural contamination re-query on {target_model}\")\n        for s_idx, seed in enumerate(seeds):\n            rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n            n_contam = int(round(contamination_fraction * len(cluster_ids)))\n            contam_ids = set(rng.choice(cluster_ids, size=n_contam, replace=False).tolist())\n            oracle_by_idx = {ci: str(c[\"oracle_correct\"]) for ci, c in enumerate(clusters)\n                             if c[\"cluster_id\"] in contam_ids}\n            try:\n                recs = await query_contaminated(\n                    panel_dict,\n                    clusters,\n                    target_model=target_model,\n                    contaminated_ids=contam_ids,\n                    oracle_by_id=oracle_by_idx,\n                    ledger=contam_ledger,\n                    concurrency=concurrency,\n                    requests_per_minute=requests_per_minute,\n                )\n            except SpendExceeded as exc:\n                logger.warning(f\"Contam spend exceeded on {target_model} seed={seed}: {exc}\")\n                break\n            # Index by cluster_id+role\n            for ci, c in enumerate(clusters):\n                if c[\"cluster_id\"] not in contam_ids:\n                    continue\n                for j, role in enumerate(c[\"variants\"].keys()):\n                    idx = j\n                    if idx >= len(recs):\n                        continue\n                    r = recs[idx]\n                    all_results[target_model].append({\n                        \"ci\": ci,\n                        \"cluster_id\": c[\"cluster_id\"],\n                        \"role\": f\"contam_{role}\",\n                        \"success\": r.success,\n                        \"parsed\": r.parsed if r.parsed is not None else None,\n                        \"input_tokens\": r.input_tokens,\n                        \"output_tokens\": r.output_tokens,\n                        \"cost_usd\": r.cost_usd,\n                    })\n            logger.info(f\"  Seed {seed}: {len(contam_ids)} contaminated clusters, \"\n                        f\"spend ${contam_ledger.total_spent:.4f}\")\n\n    logger.info(f\"Contam query done; total spend ${contam_ledger.total_spent:.4f}\")\n    return all_results\n\n\ndef stage_natural_contam_query(\n    clusters: list[dict],\n    *,\n    target_models: list[str],\n    panel: list[str],\n    seeds: list[int],\n    contamination_fraction: float = 0.30,\n    contamination_budget_usd: float = 1.0,\n    concurrency: int = 10,\n    requests_per_minute: float = 12.0,\n) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:\n    return asyncio.run(_stage_natural_contam_query_async(\n        clusters, target_models, panel, seeds,\n        contamination_fraction=contamination_fraction,\n        contamination_budget_usd=contamination_budget_usd,\n        concurrency=concurrency,\n        requests_per_minute=requests_per_minute,\n    ))\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Stage 3: coherence scoring + serialise evaluation\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef stage_score(\n    clusters: list[dict],\n    responses: dict[str, list],\n    panel: list[str],\n) -> dict:\n    logger.info(f\"Stage 3: scoring coherence ({len(panel)} models x {len(clusters)} clusters)\")\n    t0 = time.monotonic()\n    out = score_all(clusters, responses, panel)\n    dt = time.monotonic() - t0\n    logger.info(f\"Stage 3 done in {dt:.2f}s\")\n    matrix = out[\"matrix\"]\n    raw_matrix = out[\"raw_matrix\"]\n\n    metrics_agg = {\n        \"n_models\": len(panel),\n        \"n_clusters\": len(clusters),\n        \"n_cells\": int(matrix.size),\n        \"frac_score_2\": float(np.mean(matrix == 2)),\n        \"frac_score_1\": float(np.mean(matrix == 1)),\n        \"frac_score_0\": float(np.mean(matrix == 0)),\n        \"mean_ordinal_score\": float(matrix.mean()),\n        \"mean_raw_correct\": float(raw_matrix.mean()),\n        \"static_acc_mean\": float(np.mean([v[\"static_acc_on_seeds\"] for v in out[\"per_model\"].values()])),\n        \"static_acc_max\": float(np.max([v[\"static_acc_on_seeds\"] for v in out[\"per_model\"].values()])),\n        \"static_acc_min\": float(np.min([v[\"static_acc_on_seeds\"] for v in out[\"per_model\"].values()])),\n        \"static_acc_std\": float(np.std([v[\"static_acc_on_seeds\"] for v in out[\"per_model\"].values()])),\n        \"n_clusters_per_domain\": {\n            d: int(sum(1 for c in clusters if c[\"domain\"] == d))\n            for d in [\"logic\", \"arithmetic\", \"reading\", \"fol\"]\n        },\n    }\n\n    eval_out = {\n        \"metadata\": {\n            \"evaluation_name\": \"M-IRT v2 coherence scoring\",\n            \"description\": (\n                \"Ordinal coherence score (0/1/2) per (model, cluster) cell based on how many of \"\n                \"the 4 metamorphic variants the model answered correctly. v2 supports four \"\n                \"domains (logic, arithmetic, reading, fol) and uses a reference-free \"\n                \"arithmetic negation template.\"\n            ),\n            \"panel\": panel,\n            \"scoring_scheme\": (\n                \"raw_correct = #{variants where response matches oracle (with domain-specific \"\n                \"flips for logic/FOL negation, and case-insensitive string equality for \"\n                \"reading entities)}; ordinal_score = 2 if raw>=3 else 1 if raw==2 else 0.\"\n            ),\n        },\n        \"metrics_agg\": metrics_agg,\n        \"datasets\": [\n            {\n                \"dataset\": \"coherence_scoring\",\n                \"examples\": [\n                    {\n                        \"input\": ex[\"cluster_id\"],\n                        \"output\": str(ex[\"score\"]),\n                        \"metadata_model\": ex[\"model\"],\n                        \"metadata_domain\": ex[\"domain\"],\n                        \"metadata_seed_ok\": ex[\"seed_ok\"],\n                        \"metadata_raw_correct\": ex[\"raw\"],\n                        \"metadata_details\": json.dumps(ex[\"details\"]),\n                    }\n                    for ex in out[\"per_example\"]\n                ],\n            }\n        ],\n    }\n\n    EXP_EVAL_OUT = _exp_eval_path()\n    EXP_EVAL_OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    EXP_EVAL_OUT.write_text(json.dumps(eval_out, indent=2))\n    logger.info(f\"Saved {EXP_EVAL_OUT}\")\n\n    mpath = _matrices_path()\n    mpath.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    np.savez_compressed(\n        mpath,\n        score_matrix=matrix,\n        raw_matrix=raw_matrix,\n        panel=np.array(panel, dtype=object),\n        cluster_ids=np.array([c[\"cluster_id\"] for c
